par bya min dang / /rang yang ngan song gzhol ba dang / /gzhan yang phung ①bar byed pa yin/ /zhe sdang sha rul gregs pa 'di/ /nga rgyal ma zhu ston pa yin//chos rnams sgyu ma bzhin 'dod de/ /ngo bo nyid ni med phyir dang / /byis pa rmongs pa'i rgyu phyir dang / /ma byung ba las 'byung phyir ro/ /rnam par mi rtog dngos po ni/ /mkha' dang mtshungs pa nyid mi rigs/ /rnam rtog 'du shes sna tshogs kyi/ /go skabs rab tu 'byed phyir ro/ /skyes pa brjod med nyid mi rigs—/ /dgag pa gong du bstan phyir ro/ /brjod du med nyid yin gyur na'ang / /kun rdzob la ni de nyid nor/ /de la de nyid gzhan med phyir/ /gal te de nyid mthong 'dod na/ /bum la'ang bum pa gzhan med pas/ /ci phyir de nyid mthong mi 'dod/ /khyod kyi tshul skyon sba phyir gyi/ /de ni ①nyon mongs byang ①mi 'gyur/ /gser la sogs pa rkyen rnams kyi/ /rjes su 'gyur ba yin phyir ro/ /nam mkha' rtag tu rnam dag ste/ /mig ni dag dang ma dag pas—/ /dri bcas dri med mkha' 'dod dang / /chos rnams chos nyid de bzhin no/ /ma dag la sogs blo 'khrul te/ /byed pa'i chos yin las kyi min/ /de la dmigs pa dag ④ma yin/ /de nyid dmigs byar mi 'dod do/ /de nyid rdzas su yod yin na/ /skyon ni snga ma bzhin du 'gyur/ /'jig rten 'das pa rnam mi rtog /de blor mi 'dod 'jig phyir ro/ /de srid shes pa dmigs yod pa / /de srid shes bya'i rjes 'jug nyid/ /thams cad mkhyen nyid cig car min—/ /shes pa rang la 'jug pa ni/ /med phyir ral gri'i so bzhin dang / /rang rig 'gog par byed phyir ro/ /rnam par mi rtog 'phags blo'i gzung / /rnam pa kun tu brjod med nyid/ /sngar bzhin skye ba bkag pa'i phyir/ /skye 58—54

med rdzas su yod min phyir/ /yod dang med pa'i dngos nyid kyi/ /ngo bo don dam nyid yin na/ /sgro 'dogs pa dang skur mtha' las/ /grol ba khyod la ji ltar yod/ /yod min de nyid skye med phyir/ /med min de yod ma yin phyir/ /yod dang med pa gnyis spangs pas/ /de 'dod de phyir gnyis su med/ /ston pa dmigs med mi 'gyur te/ /de bzhin nyid la dmigs pa'i phyir/ /byang chub mnyam nyid mi 'gyur te/ /de nyid rang snang tha dad phyir/ /de bzhin nyid la dmigs pa'i blo/ /nus pa ma bzhag ga las 'byung / /nam mkha'i me tog snang ba'i blo/ /nus pa ma bzhag mi rigs ①bzhin/ /rang tshul sbed pas khyod kyis ni/ /de nyid gcig nyid gzhan mi 'grol/ /rdzas med dmigs su med pa'i phyir/ /nged la ji skad smras de ②rigs/ /nam mkha' 'dra ba'ang skye med pas/ /khyad par med phyir ma gos phyir/ /shin tu brjod du med nyid kyang / /blos ni rnam kun gzung med phyir/ /skye ba rab rib bral ba'i blo/ /'jig rten 'das pa yin par 'dod/ /'jig rten las sgrol don phyir dang / /'jig rten shin tu 'da' phyir ro/ /de ni mi rtogs dmigs med dang / /mtshan ma med cing de yis ni/ /rang gzhan chos nyid cig char du/ /rtogs med tshul gyis mnyam nyid rtogs/ /chos rnams skye ba med pa ni/ /chos bdag med pa nyid ces bya/ /de la rtog dri'i mtshan ma dag /'byung ba med pa snga ma bzhin—/ /gal te de nyid rtog ge yi/ /spyod yul min phyir rjes dpag pas/ /de mi rtogs pa de yi phyir/ /chos rnams chos nyid brtag ①min na/ /'di la rjes dpag skyon med pa/ /lung gis 0rjes su sgrub byed pas/ /brtags ⑤pa'i rnam rtog chu bo dag /sna tshogs ma lus bsal mdzad nas/ /sangs rgyas rnam 58—55

rtog mi mnga' ba/ /dgongs pa mkha' mnyam ye shes kyi/ /shes bya mtha' dag ji bzhin du/ /chos rnams bzhag pa nyid rtogs shing / /ming la sogs pa thob pa nyid/ /des na rjes su dpag pa'i yul/ /de nyid yin par sgrub mi nus—/ /de nyid shes pa'i mi mthun phyogs/ /gang yin de ni des zlog byed/ / lung gi ①khyad par tha dad pas/ /tha dad gyur pa'i blo la ci/ /lung gi dbye ba med pa la/ /rtogs ①par gyur pa gzhan ci yod/ /mi mthun phyogs ni spang bya na①/ /dam bcas tsam gyis ji ltar 'dod/ /rnam par rtog pa ma spangs par—/ /rnam par mi rtog blo ji ltar/ /thub pa bden pa gzigs pa yi/ /'di ltar bden pa gnyis su gsungs/ /tha snyad la ni brten dhinas su/ /de nyid don ni rtogs 'gyur phyir/ /de bzhin nyid la dmigs pa'i blo/ /dmigs dang bcas phyir brdzun yin te/ /rmi lam sogs yin de shes bya/ /des na de nyid yin mi rigs/ /gzung du med pa brjod med pa/ /shes pa'i spyod pa rnam ⑤spangs pa/ /thub pa'i dbang pos gsungs pa'i chos/ /de yis 'di ltar 'di la gnod/ /de ltar lung rigs ldan pa yi/ /de nyid gang zhig sngar bstan pa/ /rigs pas yongs su brtags na yang / /de la nyams pa med par gnas/ /kha cig phung po'i ljon shing chags/ /kha cig rnam shes rjorgya la thogs/ /yang dag mtha' yi g.yang sar yang / /ma lhung ⑦rgyal ba'i thugs ⑧sras rol/ /shes bya rnam kun ma grub phyir/ /gang la rnam par mi rtog pa'i/ /blo yang skye bar mi 'gyur ba/ /de nyid mnyam med de mkhyen gsung / /dbu ma'i snying po las rnal 'byor spyod pa pa'i de kho na nyid gtan la dbab pa la 'jug pa ste le'u lnga pa'o// //58—56

rang bzhin gang zhig rtogs pa med①/ /yon tan gsum dang skyed bdag nyid—/ /de las bzlog pas skyes bu nyid/ /'di dag rtag tu goms par bya/ /rtsa ba'i rang bzhin mi 'gyur ba/ /chen po la sogs rnam pa bdun/ /rang bzhin 'gyur ba bdun nyid do/ /'gyur ba rnam pa bcu drug kyang / /rang bzhin 'gyur ba min skyes bu/ /yid las ②snying stobs skyes pa can/ /skyes bu'i gzugs brnyan 'byung ba'am/ /de bzhin yongs su gyur nas ni/ /blo 'jug pa yi rjes su byed/ /bdag kyang gzhan la rang bzhin gzhan/ /'di ltar de nyid mthong ba yi/ /byed dang bya ba ldog pa yi/ /skyes bu grol ba yin zhes brjod/ /bdag dang bdag med rtogs pa'am/ /don byas pa na rjes gzung ①ba/ /rang bzhin byis ni grol yin phyir/ /de nyid yin par grangs can smra/ /de la gtso bo skyes bu ni/ /ji ltar mi rigs las sngar bstan/ /de yang yang 'dir brtag bya ste/ /bdag ni rtogs rjopa ma yin no/ /shes bya rtogs pas rtogs yin na/ /shes bya med pas de yang med/ /rtogs pa can nam rtogs rjomed pa/ /'dir ni bdag tu gang zhig 'gyur/ /ma bsregs sreg bupar mi rigs te/ /bsregs pa med phyir de sngon bzhin/ /des na sreg byed dpe yis ni/ /rtogs pa'i bdag nyid grub ma yin/ /shes bya'i rnam pa 'dzin byed pas/ /shes la rtogs pa zhes 'dod de/ /dngos po byed pa la brten phyir/ /de yang skyes bu 'di la brten/ /brtags pa byas pa yin na ni/ /skyes bu 'gyur med rang gi yul/ /de dang 'di ni lugs 'dis 'gal/ /shes las rtogs pa gzhan min pas/ /ci zhig gzhan du brtag par bya/ /rtogs pa blo gros ma yin te/ /rgyu dang ldan phyir bum pa bzhin/ /des na rtogs pa shes 58—57

pa min/ /gal te blo la de snyam na/ /rtogs las shes pa gzhan yin par/ /sgrub byed ce na dpe yang med/ /shes pa'ang de dngos med ce na/ /khas blangs pa yis gnod pa yin/ /ma skyes pa ni rtogs min te/ /ma skyes phyir na rigs ldan min/ /blo yi 'jug pa'i khyad par ni/ /gang phyir shes la ①'jug 'dod na'ang / /tha dad khyad can nyid 'gyur gyi/ /de med pas na de yang med—/ /gal te bdag gi blo gang yang / /la lar ji bzhin don du 'dod/ /la lar de las bzlog nyid de/ /mtho la mtho yi blo bzhin no/ /la lar ji ltar ji bzhin don/ /zhe na kun rdzob grub pa sgrub/ /ji bzhin don gyi sems kyi yul—/ /bdag ces bya bar bdag cag 'dod/ /ci ste kun la khyab sogs kyi//mtshan nyid can blo don bzhin na/ /de nyid du 'am kun rdzob tu'ang / /dpe ni yod pa ma yin no/ /rtogs pa med pas rtogs pa ni/ /rang bzhin rtogs pa med pa'am/ /gang gi de nyid shes skye bas/ /gang zhig grol bar 'gyur ba yin—/ /rtogs pas 'dzin par byed pa na/ /bdag ni 'di ltar zhes sogs des—/ /rtogs lapa med phyir gzhan mi rigs/ /de med gyur na yang ci zhig /'di yi ldog pa'ang rigs min te/ /mang po dag dang thun mong phyir/ /ji ltar rje gcig shi gyur kyang / /tshogs pa dag gi ①bran bzhin 'dod/ /tha dad yul la ma bgrebs ④phyir/ /ji ltar bdag gi dbye ba las/ /skyes bu'i yid la snying stobs dag /lhag pas de nyid mthong bar 'dod/ /sgra la sogs pa rtogs pa dang / /de bzhin chos dang chos min dag /skyon ni rjes su mtshungs pa'i phyir/ /ma mthong nges pa med pa'ang yin/ /gal te skyes bu 'gyur zhe na/ /skyes bu rtogs pa med pa dang / /rgyu med khyab pa ma yin te/ /58—58

skyes bu 'gyur phyir 'o ma bzhin/ /sems ni 'gyur ba med na yang / /gzugs brnyan rmi ni rgyu yin phyir/ /ji skad smras pa'i skyon ldan par/ / 'gyur te ①gdong gi gzugs brnyan bzhin/ /skyes bu rtog pa med pa'i phyir/ /bdag dang gzhan zhes mi rigs so/ /brtags nas skyon med ce na yang / /grol ba brtags pa nyid du 'gyur/ /gtso bo yod de sna tshogs kyi/ /rjes su 'gro phyir yongs gyur ②phyir/ /bya dang byed pa'i ngo bo'i phyir/ /nus phyir sna tshogs ngo bo'i phyir/ /ji skad smras pa ①de bzhin te/ /snod chag pa yi dum sogs ltar/ /de bzhin dbye ba de dang ldan/ /des na dbye ba rgyu dang bcas/ /dbye rnams rgyu dang bcas nyid du/ /sgrub byed ce na grub pa sgrub/ /kun la khyab par ma grub ste/ /'di yi gtan tshigs ma grub phyir/ /spyi ni sngon du song 'dod de/ /spyi dang ldan pa'i phyir zhe na/ /spyi nyid dam ni khyad par la/ /snga ma bzhin du dpe yang med/ /bde la sogs pa'i ngo bo'i phyir/ /tshor ba'i phung po bzhin mi 'dod/ /phung po yin phyir bde sdug sogs/ /so sor ma nges pa nyid yin/ /ma nges pa yis spangs pas ④na/ /de ltar don byed bdag nyid yin/ / rgyu dang ldan pa yin pa'i phyir/ /⑤rjes 'gro sogs kyi burjes dpag gi/ /dam bcas skyon gyis gnod pa yin/ /skye med mtha' med nyid sogs kyi/ /de yis ⑦khyad par spangs pas na/ /gtso bo'i yon tan 'dod pa yi/ /gtan tshigs ma nges pa nyid yin/ /de bzhin tha dad rgyu las kyang / /'byung bar 'dod pa'i dpe yod min/ /tsan+dan dum bur gyur pa na/ /nyams pa min par rtogs bya ste/ /stobs dang gzugs dang tshad la sogs/ /nye bar gnas te bdag nyid bzhin/ /nus pa'i bdag nyid nyid du ste/ /yod 58—59

na sngar bzhin dpe mi 'grub/ /gsal ①ba'i ngo bor de yod na'ang / /grub pa'i mtha' ni spang bar ④'gyur/ /bya dang byed pa gcig nyid du/ /sgrub na'ang smras pa'i tshul nyid yin/ /rigs mthun nyid la gcig nyid du/ /sgrub 1na'ang grub pa sgrub ④pa yin/ /de las don gzhan tog ⑤na yang / /snga ma bzhin du skyon kun 'byung / /bde dang sdug bsngal sogs kun du/ /gtan tshigs ma nges pa nyid yin/ /dus dbyer med pas gzhan min na'ang / /grags dang lung dang 'gal ba nyid/ /tsan+dan ngo bo mi mngon pas/ /med par grub pa ma yin te/ /dus dang drug pas bstan pa'i phyir/ /de rjoltar skad cig bzhin zhe na/ /de lta na yang spro gyur nas/ /rang gi lugs kyi skyon sbed kyang / /smras pa'i skyon rnams med min te/ /gyen du skra 'greng bum 'dra bzhin/ /de gzugs she na gtan tshigs don/ /rnam par rtog pa ma nges nyid/ /dbyer med ngo bo yin na yang / /gtan tshigs ma nges pa nyid yin/ /rna sogs spyad bya ba yin te/ /rtogs ⑦pa med phyir gal te 'dod/ /khyad par dag ni ma bstan par/ /spyad bya'o zhe na grub pa sgrub/ /ci ste g.yo ba med sogs kyi/ /khyad par can na dze+es 'gro gang / /rtogs par bden yang rtsol med phyir/ /spyod pa por ni mi 'dod do/ /dngos rnams bya ba med nyid du/ /rab tu rtogs te gzhal bya'i phyir/ /smras pa ci khrultar de de ltar/ /rtogs te bde dang gti mug bzhin/ /bya ba med par sdug bsngal yang / /shes par bya ste rgyud ldan phyir/ /rtogs pa med phyir brjod bya'i phyir/ /gzhal bya yin phyir gti mug bzhin/ /rjes 'gro la sogs gtan tshigs rnams/ /tha dad nyid du 'dod pas na/ /gtso bo'i yon tan la de rnams/ /ma nges ma yin pa de 58—60

bden—/ /bya dang byed pa sgrub bcas phyir/ /rgyu dang ldan par rjes dpag nyid—/ /gtan tshigs rnams kyang khyad bcas pas/ /de ltar 'gal ba nyid du 'gyur/ /de ma bzung bar mi 'dzin pas/ /gzugs sogs gzhan min de dngos ①bzhin/ /tha dad dngos phyir gzhan min min/ /gang de rtogs bya rtogs byed phyir/ /des na mi mngon ma yin la/ /bya bar yod pa'ang mi 'dod do/ /da ltar gyi na skad cig kyang / /rjes ②su yod par ma grags nyid/ /spyod dang ①bcas pa'i spyad bya 'di/ /spyad bya yin phyir mal sogs bzhin/ /rtogs pa po ni spyod pa nyid/ /de yi sgrub par byed pa min/ /rtogs pa nges par rtogs yin na/ /de ni gang gi yin pa spros/ /dngos po byed po la brten te/ /gos sogs tshon du btsos pa bzhin/ /sgra sogs shes par mi 'gyur ba/ /yin na'ang shes pa ji ltar yin/ /sgra sogs shes par 'gyur ba nyid/ /yin na'ang shes pa ji ltar yin/ /byed pa med pa ma skyes phyir/ /byed po nyid du ji ltar 'dod—/ /ma skyes pa la bdogs rjon yang / /skyes bu btags pa pa ru 'gyur//byed po'i sgra yis rjobarjod bya'i phyir/ /me bzhin khyod kyi duskyes bu yang / /rgyu bcas bya bcas spyad bya dang / /bya ba rab tu bskyed pa'ang yin/ /kun khyab ma yin rang bzhin las/ /gzhan pa ma yin skyes bu min/ /de yi ⑦rang dngos khyad par ni/ /de yis 'di ltar spong bar 'gyur/ /des na khas blangs pa de la/ /gnod phyir dam bcas skyon med min/ /ji ltar dbang phyug rgyur smra ⑧bzhin—/ /rtogs ⑨pa la sogs spangs pa yin/ /bdag dang bdag gi min rtogs pa/ /blo yi ⑩rjes su rtogs pa yi/ /lta ba log pas grol bar ni/ /khyod kyi skyes bu 'gyur mi rigs/ /skyes bu tha dad mthong ba yis⑪ thar pa 58—61

'thob ①pa ma yin te/ /blo gzhan yin phyir spyad bya dang / /skyes bu gzhan nyid mthong ba bzhin/ /ji ltar rnam rtog bcas pa'i phyir/ /mi ni tha dad mjong ba ltar/ /skyes bu tha dad mthong ba yis/ /de bzhin grol ba mi 'dod do—/ /de ltar grangs can de nyid ni/ /sngon dang phyi mar 'gal ba dang / /rigs pa dang — mi ldan la/ /mkhas pa rnams kyi blo mi 'jug /n+ya gro dha yi sdes bon gyi/ /nang na yod pa'i n+ya gro dang / /bud med skyes pa 'grogs la bu/ /rnga yi nang na sgra gnas dang / /zas kyi nang na phyi sa sogs/ /shing la 'bar yod mi mthong zhes/ /gang zhig mngon sum spong byed pa/ /de ni bden smra ji ltar yin/ /de ni yod kyang mi gsal bas/ /des na bya ba mngon ①ma mthong /zhe na mi gsal med min pas/ /e ma'o bstan bcos shin tu legs/ /dbu ma'i snying po las grangs can gyi de kho na nyid la 'jug pa ste le'u drug pa'o// //blo sogs bdag gi yon tan bcad/ /drungs nas phyung ba'i rnal 'byor pa//yid la bdag ces gnas pa ni/ /bye brag pa yis rjothar par shes/ /rgyas par sngar bstan rim pa yis/ /mi bden skye ba bkag pa 'am/ /dngos po yongs su bkag pas na/ /'dod dang sdang sogs yon tan med/ /ma skyes byed por mi rung ste/ /bya ba nges par bya ba la/ /byed po yin phyir sbrang rtsi'i rgyu/ /nam mkha'i me tog min pa bzhin/ /ma skyes skyes pa ma yin te/ /nam mkha'i me tog ma skyes bzhin/ /'byung ba'i ngo bo la sogs kyi/ /don dam par na yod min te/ /rtag pa'i bdag la shes mi brten/ /rgyu dang ldan phyir bum pa bzhin—/ /blo ni bdag gi yon tan du/ /mi rigs skye dang ldan pa'i phyir/ /58—62

ji ltar de yi yon tan du/ /gzugs la sogs pa mi 'dod bzhin/ /'du ba yin phyir bdag med pas/ /rigs te mi rtag pa yi phyir/ /de ltar bde dang sdug bsngal sogs/ /dgag pa mthar thug ①shes par bya/ /yid ni rtag pa sdemin par 'dod/ /brjod bya yin phyir bum pa bzhin/ /'di ni bdag gi byed pa min/ /dngos po yin phyir bde ba bzhin/ /bdag yod pa ni bkag zin kyang / /'dir yang brtag par bya ba ste/ /brten nas byung ba ma yin phyir/ /bdag med nam mkha'i me tog bzhin/ /de yi spyi ni yod par yang / /khas len pa yang brtag par bya/ /'di ni khyab min rtag pa min/ /rtogs bya yin phyir bum pa bzhin/ /blo skye 'gyur dang bcas she na/ /khyod kyi bdag nyid nyams par 'gyur/ /'on te 'gyur med shes pa min/ /shes dang shes min ji ltar rung / /'du ba dgag pa byas pas na/ /de dang 'byel pa'ang rigs pa min—/ /bde dang sdug bsngal 'bad dang 'dod/ /sdang la sogs kyang tshul 'di yin/ /brtag ①pa'i bdag la bde mi rtenadhi/ /rgyu dang ldan phyir bum pa bzhinaske/ /yang na bdag gi yon tan ni/ /bde ba yin par ma rtogs ⑤te/ /skye dang ldan phyir gzugs la sogs/ /de yi yon tan mi 'dod bzhin/ /yang na 'di dag 'du ba ni/ /bdag la yod par ma rtogs bunyid/ /lhan cig yod chen dang 'brel bar/ /yod dang ⑦med pa mi rigs so/ /yod na'ang de ④sbyor don med la/ /med na de yang med par 'gyur/ /gsal bar byed pa chos gzhan phyir/ /de ni gsal byed ji ltar yin/ /grangs la sogs dang 'byel ba yang / /'di nyid kyis ni lan btab po/ /gal te spyi sogs dang 'grel bas/ /skyes bu spyi dang gcig rtogs ⑨par/ /de sogs rkyen dang phrad 58—63

tsam gyis/ /skyes bu 'byung bar 'dod na ni/ /yod min med min du ma min/ /gcig min phra min chen po min/ /'di ni rtag min mi rtag min/ /gzhan min gzhan min min de nyid/ /ji ltar bdag bzhin tshig gi don/ /gzhan yang 'di ltar stong pa de/ /'bad nas gsangs ①su zin kyang ni/ /gzegs zan pa yis gsal bar byas/ /'di dag mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i phyir/ /de nyid mthong bar mi rigs so/ /mtshan ma mi bden par skyes pa'i/ /ngo bo rtag par mi bden 'dod/ /bdag las tha dad gyur pa'i don/ /de dang 'byel par mi 'dod de/ /yod pa'i blo phyir blo spyi la/ /spyi zhes bya bar 'dod pa bzhin/ /de bzhin grangs sogs 'byel pa yang / /bdag gam gzhan pa la la la/ /mkhas pas ji ltar rigs pa bzhin/ /blo de min par rtogs snepar bya//bdag ni blo dang sdug bsngal dang / /bde sogs yon tan dang mi ①'bral/ /yon tan yin phyir grangs bzhin no/ /de phyir yon tan med bdag min/ /yul dang ngo bor dbyer med kyang / /gang zhig rang gi bdag nyid 'gyur/ /bdag dang sbyor bar 'dod pa las/ /dran nas shes pa kun tu 'byung / /ma mthong nges pa'ang sngar bzhin du/ / thal 'gyur lan yang 'di la yin/ /med pa'i skye ba bkag pas na/ /de yi spyor ba'ang mi 'dod do/ /yid dang bdag gi med pa la/ /rten dang brten par mi 'dod do/ /bdag dang yid ni yod na yang / /rten dang brten par mi 'dod do/ /rnam rtog rgyu mtshan bcas pa'i phyir/ /rdzas sogs mthong bas grol bar ni/ /ji ltar 'ug pa mi 'dod pa/ /de bzhin 'ug pa pa mi 'dod/ /sa sogs de nyid 'byung ba'i blo/ /thar pa min par gzegs zan 'dod/ /khyad par dag ni mi 'dzin phyir/ /'tsho 58—64

ba'i de nyid blo bzhin no/ /bye brag pa yi de nyid la'ang / /lta ngan rab rib skyes pas na/ /des na rigs ①pa dang bral phyir/ /blo ni dga' bar mi bya'o/ /dbu ma'i snying po las bye brag pa'i de kho na nyid la 'jug pa ste le'u bdun pa'o// //rig byed mthar smras smras pa ni/ /'dus byas stong par smra ba yi/ /phyi rol pa la bdag rig dkon/ /bdag sdang ②thar pa ga la yod/ /mun pa las gzhan skyes bu ni/ /chen por gyur pa nyi ma'i 'od/ /dbang phyug chen po bdag de nyid/ /mkhas pas shes na 'chi med 'gyur/ /byed po dbang phyug gser mdog tu/ /gang gis mthong zhing blta ba de/ /sdig dang bsod nams las 'das nas/ /mchog tu zhi ba thob par 'gyur/ /byung gyur byung dang 'byung ba dag /thams cad skyes bu yin 'dod de/ /de ni phyi nang ring ba dang / /de ni nye dhidang de las byed/ /srid pa sna tshogs de las skyes/ /dar gye srin bu'i skud pa bzhin/ /mkhas pa de yi char thim pa/ /yang srid len par mi 'gyur ro—/ /'chi bcas rnams la bdud rtsi med/ /me la grang ba ji bzhin no/ /des na bdud rtsi skyes bu nyid/ /ma rtogs bdud rtsi yod mi rigs/ /gang las mchog gyur gzhan med phyir/ /gang las dam pa gzhan med ladhi/ /'di las phra gyur gzhan med pas/ /sna tshogs 'di dag rgyu gcig nyid/ /de ni phra dang rags dang ldan/ /yang ldan gtso bo dbang bsgyur ⑤ba/ /rab phye 'dod pa'i mthar thug gang / /rnal 'byor ji ltar 'dod par 'gro/ /der ni 'byung ba thams cad kyang / /bdag nyid du ni 'dus par mthong / /byes dang mkhas dang gdol pa dang / /bram ze sogs rnams mnyam pa nyid/ /bum 58—65

pa 'byung zhing 'jig pa ltar/ /nam mkha' de yi bdag nyid min/ /lus can 'byung zhing 'jig pa ltar/ /de bdag yin pas bdag mi 'dod/ /bum pa'i nam mkha' bzhin du gcig /du ma'o zhe na bum pa dag / chag na dbyer ①med cig nyid du/ /thams cad mnyam ①par 'gyur bar 'dod/ /ji ltar bum sogs tha dad kyang / /sa la tha dad 'ga' yang med/ /de bzhin lus ni tha dad kyang / /bdag la tha dad 'ga' yang med/ /ji ltar bum pa'i nam mkha' gcig /rdul dang du bas bsgribs pa na/ /thams cad de bzhin ma yin ltar/ /bde sogs de bzhin bdag la min/ /bdag ma shes shing ma rtogs pas/ /rmi lam longs spyod nga rgyal bzhin/ /las rnams sogs shing dge ba dang / /mi dge'i 'bras bu spyod pa yin/ /lus la gnas kyang ma chags dang / /spyod par byed kyang mi gos te/ /'dod bzhin spyod kyang rgyal po bzhin/ /sdog pas gnod par mi 'gyur ro/ /gcig po ①kun khyab rtag pa ste—/ /tshangs mchog 'chi ba med pa'i gnas/ /rnal 'byor pa yis goms byas na/ /de ni yang srid len mi 'gyur/ /de ni rtag par rtog med pa/ /gang rjogi spyod yul gang ma gyur/ /blo ni dbye bas phrogs rnams kyis/ /de la tshig tu sbyor bar byed/ /phyogs su lhung ba ma yin pas/ /'dir ni 'di yang 'di ltar dpyad/ /phyogs la chags pas bsgribs pa'i blos/ /ji ltar bden pa'ang rtogs mi 'gyur/ /bdag yod pas ni bkag pa na/ /'gro ba'i rgyu yang de bzhin te/ /des na de mthong grol ba ni/ /mi bden par ni rab brtags nyid—/ /byol song rnams la 'jig rjotshogs lta/ /lhan cig skyes yod zhi ma gyur//kun nyon mongs kun rtsa ba'i phyir/ /de nyid khyod kyis rjoshin tu spel/ /'jig 58—66

tshogs lta la zhen pa yi/ /bdag 'dzin bdag gir ①'dzin pa dag /gang las 'khor bar 'byung 'gyur ba/ /de nyid grol ba yin par smra/ /myos par gyur la myos 'gyur bzhin/ /de lta ba yis ①zhi gyur na/ /shin tu ma zhu'i nad ldan la/ /kha zas zos pas phan par 'gyur/ /rig byed smra bas bdag de ni/ /rnam pa gnyis su 'dod byed de/ /lus zhes bya ba bcings bdag dang / /mchog na gnas pa grol ba'i bdag /mchog tu 'dzin pa bdag gi yul/ /bdag blo ji bzhin don ma yin/ /bdag ni 'di zhes mchog 'dzin phyir/ /lus la bdag gi blo bzhin no/ /yongs su btags pa yod na yang / /khyod kyi bdag gis ①ci zhig byed/ /gzugs dang sgra sogs yul rnams la/ /blo'o zhe na de mi rigs/ /gzugs sogs yul la blo dag ni/ /byed po bdag ni med kyang skyed/ /rkyen la ltos pa'i skye yin phyir/ /me shel gyi ni me bzhin no/ /gang yang yi ge'i bdag nyid sgra/ /de yi byed po bdag min du'adod/ /mnyan bya'i phyir dang sgra yin phyir/ /dper na brag ca ji bzhin no/ /'dis ni lus kyi bya ba gzhan/ /'ong ba dang ni 'gro ba dang / /lag pa rkang pa g.yo ba ni/ /mtshan nyid lhag ma rnams kyang bkag /rnam par bcad nas kun shes las//kun shes dran pa nyid las dran/ /so sor rnam par rab shes las/ /shes rab nyams su myong las tshor/ /shes sogs byed par smra zhe na/ /byed pa nyid du sgrub pa'am/ /de las gzhan pa'i byed po nyid/ /gcod byed bzhin du rigs ldan min/ /byed pa po la rkyen ldan zhing / /gang phyir byed pa la min pas—/ /des na gtan tshigs ma grub pa'am/ /ma nges pa nyid yin par 'gyur—/ /shes la sogs pa byed po nyid/ /byed po'i sgra yis dubarjod pa'i 58—67

phyir| /lhas sbyin gyis ni gcod do zhes/ /ji ltar byed por mthong ba bzhin//'dus byas phung po byed ①bral nyid/ /'di la byed por brjod bya ste/ /byed pa yin phyir mar me yis⑤/ /gsal bar byed pa yin pa bzhin/ /yang dag gtso gcig byed po min/ /gang phyir gcig gis bum mi byed/ /des na mar me sogs byed po/ /gdags pa par ni mi 'dod do/ /'dod chags sogs kyi dbang phyug sems/ /gzugs sogs yul la mngon zhen pa'i/ /thar pa mi mthun phyogs kyis phrogs/ /'khor ba'i btson rar bcings pa yin/ /lag pa la sogs tshogs pa ni/ /sems bcas sems can zhes bya ste/ /gtong ba la sogs sems 'byung ba/ /yod pa gtong po ①la sogs brjod/ /rig pa skyes pas ma rig dusogs/ /kun sbyor ldog par gyur pa'i phyir/ /chags sogs 'ching ba las grol ba/ /grol ba zhes ni brjod pa yin/ /nam mkha' 'dra ba'i bdag la ni/ /'di dag thams cad brjod par dka'/ /gal te bdag la lhag chags na/ /nam mkha'i me tog bdag 'dod kyis/ /gang phyir bdag ni rang bzhin gyisadu/ /shes pa'i ngo bor 'dod na ni/ /byed pa la sogs ltos pa'i phyir/ /de ni gcig tu mi rigs so/ /bdag sogs shes bya yod pas na/ /shes pa ldog par mi 'gyur te/ /don byas zin pa'i mar me yang / /rang gi rgyu las skye bar mthong / /ci srid yid la shes 'byung ba/ /de srid sa bon sogs 'gyur te/ /ji rjosrid sgra ni yod gyur pa/ /de srid sgra brnyan 'byung ba bzhin/ /byed pa med par shes pa ni/ /'khor ba ji ltar shes pa yin/ /kun tu khyab med yin pa'i phyir/ /gang las ji ltar bcings dang grol/ /sdug bsngal las kyang thar min te/ /thar dang gcig tu smra ba'i 58—68

phyir—/ /bdag las de ni gzhan min phyir/ /ji ltar me dang tsha ba bzhin/ /nyams dang ma skyes pa yi blo/ /byed pa med par ji ltar yin①/ /gang pos gcod par byed pa yang / /sta re med par sdeji ltar rigs/ /me yis bsreg ①ces smras pa na/ /me yis bsregs kyi byed pas min/ /de bzhin blo yis rig smras pas/ /shes pas rig gi skyes bus min/ /rdza mkhan bzhin du de mi 'grub//de yi ngo bor rjomed pa'i phyir/ /sred ⑤byed bzhin du 'ang 'grub mi 'dod/ /bsreg bya med pas me med phyir/ /gal te mi shes byed po dang / /za po khyod kyis shes ci rjoltar/ /mkha' 'dra rtog pa med pa yang / /lung 'ba' zhig gis brtags ci bya/ /mi shes pa'am shes dngos min/ /'di ni dngos po med par 'gyur—/ /dngos med bdag tu mi 'gyur te/ /'di ni mo gsham bu bzhin no—/ /gang la gnod dang phan pa las/ /gang la gnod dang bde mi 'byung / /de de'i ⑦bdag tu mi rigs te/ /nam mkha' de ba shar ma'i bzhin/ /nyi che'i bdag dang grol bar ni/ /bsam gtan shes sogs kyis 'dod na/ /bdag med don la 'bad pa yis⑧/ /shi ba mi 'chir ji ltar 'gyur/ /nyi che'i bdag ni bdag las gzhan/ /zhe na thams cad skyes bu yin/ /de ni nyi tshe gnyis dag dang / /phyi zhes dam bcas nyams pa yin/ /bdag las nyi che'i bdag de ni/ /gzhan min zhe na'ang dam bcas nyams/ /gang yang bdag gi bde sdug sogs/ /'gro bas mi shes gtso bo min/ /gal te phra yin 'di che min/ /chen po yin na phra ba min/ /gcig kyang ma yin gzugs kyi chos/ /ji ltar gzugs med bdag gi yin/ /gcig nyid du ma'i ngo bo ru/ /glang po'i dpe 'di mi rigs te/ /sna ni glang du mi 'dod phyir/ /sna tshogs rnams kyang 58—69

gcig nyid min/ /gang yang bdag ni nyi sogs mdog /yin na mdog bral ji ltar yin/ /bdag de du ma'i ngo bo yi/ /dper ni pa la sha mi 'dod/ /gcig pu pa la sha med de①/ /kun tu 'gyur ba'i bdag nyid dang / /ji ltar rtsa ba sogs du mar/ /rkyen la sogs pas 'byed pa'i phyir/ /gtso bo nyid dang dam pa nyid/ /de las gzhan la ltos nas 'dod/ /gcig nyid yin na tshul 'di nyid/ /yod par ji ltar 'dod par bya/ /gal te bdag de rdzas yin na/ /rdzas yin phyir na kun khyab min/ /bum pa bzhin du rtag mi 'gyur/ /des na 'gro ba rgyas ji ltar/ /rdzas ni rten du rigs 'gyur ⑤na/ /bdag ni rdzas su mi rigs te/ /nam mkha'i me tog ji lta bar/ /de bzhin ma skyes phyir rdzas med/ /thams cad byung gyur byung ba dang / /'byung 'gyur bdag med ji ltar mthong / /bdag med bdag tu mi rigs te/ /ji ltar dngos med ngo bo bzhin—/ /byis sogs khyad par med ma yin/ /brten med pa dang dpe med phyir—/ /bdag gcig yin na du ma yi/ /skyon rnams 'byung bar 'gyur ma yin—/ /tse tra'i bdag de me tra'i byed/ /me tra'i bdag gi'ang de bzhin te/ /tse tra tha dad min dngos phyir/ /yang na yul la dbyer ①med phyir/ /bde dang sdug bsngal spyod pa dang / /de grol bas kyang grol ba dang / /de bcings pas kyang bcings pa dang / /de sdug pas kyang sdug nyid 'gyur/ /bum pa'i nam mkha' dper bstan pa/ /kun la de ni 'byung ma yin/ /gang phyir nam mkha' gcig nyid du/ /khyod kyi de ni ma grub ste/ /rdzas kyi ngo bos gang stong pa/ /de ni kun rdzob nam mkha' yin/ /de la 'gro ldan 'gro ba dang / /de ni skabs 'dod skabs can no/ /des na nam mkha'i sgrib med min/ /skabs sbyin pa 58—70

yang ma yin te/ /de yod gtan tshigs smras pa yis/ /gtan tshigs 'di yang ma grub nyid/ /rgyu las ①nye bar ma byung ba/ /nam mkha' dngos por mi 'dod do—/ /de ni gcig kyang ma yin te/ /mo gsham byi ni bu bzhin no/ /bum sogs gzugs kyi sa rnams ni/ /sa yi rigs su gcig na yang / /rdza sogs gzhan dang gzhan yin ltar/ /des na bdag ②ni gcig ma yin/ /bdag ma shes shing ma rtags ①pas/ /rmi lam longs spyod nga rgyal bzhin/ /shes nyid phyin ci ma log rjopas/ /shes 'di nga rgyal mi rigs so/ /mi shes nyid na 'ang log med pas/ /mi shes nga rgyal mi 'dod do/ /nam mkha' bzhin du 'gyur med phyir/ /de bzhin chags pa med pa'i phyir/ /bdag ni byed por mi rigs la—/ /za ba por yang mi rigs so/ /byed po bdag yin mi gos pa/ /byed po'i 'bras bu 'dod ci ltar/ /mi dbang sdig dang bcas pa'i phyir/ /rgyal po'i dpe ni mi rigs so/ /phyi rol la ni ma ltos par/ /gcig nyid ngo bo nyid mi rigs/ /gcig nyid dang ldan pas she na/ /de ni de dang ldan ma yin//du ma nyid du brtags pa dag /gsal ba gcig nyid yin zhe na/ /ji ltar brtags pa kun rdzob phyir/ /des na gcig ste ⑤don dam min/ /rtag dang gcig sogs ngo bo yis/ /don dam de yod yin zhe na/ /gcig sogs sgra dang blo 'jug pa/ /don yod na ni skyon med 'gyur/ /gcig la sogs par rnam rtog pa/ /'di ni ci bultar mi rtag nyid/ /rnam par rtog ④pa'i yul don la—/ /tshig 'jug par ni ma bkag go/ /'di ltar blo yi yul min dang / /ngag gi spyod yul min ci ltar/ /brjod med rtog pa med pa yang / /sngar bstan rigs ⑧pas brdzun pa nyid/ /shes bya ye nas ma grub pas/ /blo yi yul 58—71

du mi rigs so/ /blo yi yul las log pas na/ /ngag gi yul las log pa'ang yin—/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i mi brdzun pa'i/ /lugs 'di dge bar shes nas ni/ /de phyir mu stegs 'dod skyes te/ /de la bdag gir byas pa yin/ /sngon dang phyi mar 'gal ba yi①/ /de yi lugs la su zhig dad/ /shin tu rigs mi gcig pa'i phyir/ /lcags las nor bu rin chen bzhin/ /'di ltar 'di ni lugs 'di la/ /kha cig dag ni drang phyir dang / /lhag ma 'dzin las bzlog pa'i phyir/ /sna tshogs dag tu bstan pa yin/ /dngos po rnams ni ma skyes nyid/ /rang bzhin bcos ma med pa'i phyir/ /'di la nyams pa med pas na / /bdag ces kyang ni brjod pa yin/ /tha dad dngos kyang dbyer ②med phyir—/ /ngo bo gcig phyir gcig nyid yin/ /kun khyab chos rnams thams cad phyir/ /rtag pa 'ang de yin mi nyams phyir/ /ma skyes phyir na skye med nyid//de nyid phyir na rga shi med/ /'pho ba med phyir 'di 'pho med/ /rab mthar thug ④phyir mchog yin nyid/ /gzugs dang sgra dang dri sogs min/ /sa dang me dang chu rlung min/ /nam mkha' zla ba nyi ma min/ /yid dang shes pa'i mtshan nyid min/ /thams cad 'di yin rang bzhin phyir/ /nyams pa med phyir thams cad min/ /de la nyon mongs skye med phyir/ /dag pa 'di yin zhi nyid 'di/ /de ni brtags pas sgo btags nasadu/ /brjod bya yang dag brjod bya min/ /ye nas brjod bya ma yin phyir/ /'di ni dri ma med ces bstan—/ /gang zhig 'di lhar mngon 'dod pa/ /khyod kyis bdag kyang yin na ni/ /ming sogs chos mang 'dra ba la/ /skyon med rigs ⑤pa dang bcas yin—/ /bdag med nyid kyis 'jigs pa rnams/ /'jigs kyang de nyid la 58—72

gnas te/ /nam mkha' 'jigs par gyur pa dag /gzhan pa'i gnas 'ga' 'ang ①med pa bzhin/ /sangs rgyas 'jig rten gnyen rnams kyi/ /de nyid bdud rtsi mchog 'di la/ /'di ni 'ga' yang bkag med pas/ /legs par 'ongs so ngoms par gyis/ /yang dag lta la sgrib med pa'i/ /bdag ni byed po za po sogs/ /rten med brdzun pa'i 'dzin pa ni/ /des na spang ba kho nar gyis—/ /dngos rnams rang bzhin skye med phyir/ /de nyid du na skye med 'dod//ngo bo nyid kyis skye med nyid/ /'di yi ngo bo nyid du bstan/ /dngos med nyid ni ①bdag med pa/ /de ni bdag min 'gal ba nyid/ /bdag med bdag tu 'gyur zhe na/ /ba lang min pa'ang ba lang 'gyur/ /dngos po'i ngo bo med 'di ni/ /'di ltar byed po za por rigs/ /gang phyir mo gsham dag gi bu/ /byed po za por ma yin bzhin/ /de ltar gyur la skye ji ltar| /de las nyams par 'gyur ji ltar/ /mkha' la me tog med pa la//ji ltar skye 'jig btags pa bzhin/ /dngos po med pa'i yul dag la/ /ji srid blo ni 'jug gyur pa/ /blo yis btags pas sgo btags phyir/ /de srid gcig la sogs par 'dod/ /rtog bcas rtog pa med pa las④/ /gang tshe blo ni log gyur pa/ /de tshe blo la yul med phyir/ /spros pa nyer zhi zhi ba nyid/ /dbu ma'i snying po las rig byed kyi mtha' rgyur smra ba'i de kho na nyid la 'jug pa ste le'u brgyad pa'o// //ngo tsha med pa kha cig ni/ /byang grol legs lam bsam gtan dang / /shes la skur 'debs bya ba tsam/ /bdag rjogis de ni 'thob par sems/ /58—73

chags sogs skyon gyis nyams pa'i phyir/ /skyes bu'i tshig ni brdzun ①nyid yin/ /rig byed skyes bus ma byas phyir/ /des na tshad mar gzung bar bya/ /byed po mi dran par 'dod phyir/ /rig byed skyes bus ma byas la①/ /brgyud nas 'ongs pa ma chad phyir/ /des na lung yin de med na/ /sgra rtag dbyangs kyis ④gsal bar byed/ /don dang 'byel pa rtag pa nyid/ /don la rtogs dupa dang ldan la/ /rtogs pa rab tu skye bar 'gyur/ /lan cig 'jug phyir goms pa'i phyir/ /phyis kyang shes phyir de bzhin du/ /mnyan bya yin phyir sgra nyid bzhin/ /sgra ni rtag par shes par bya/ /mngon sum rjes su dpag pa dang / /sgra las ⑤byung dang nyer 'jal bcas/ /don gyis dugo dang dngos med pa'i/ /gtan tshigs bsgrub ⑦bya sgrub par byed/ /'di ni rjes dpag las tha dad/ /tshad ma yin phyir gzhan de bzhin/ /yang na gcig dang du ma'i yul/ /rtogs ⑧par gyur pa ji bzhin no/ /rtags ⑨dang 'byel pa ma mthong ba'i/ /dngos don blo yi rgyu phyir ram/ /yang na tha dad blo skye ba'i/ /rgyur gyur pa nyid yin phyir ro/ /sngon med pa yang bya bas gsal/ /thar pa'ang bya bas sgrub par byed/ /mkhas gang zla ba'i btung sogs kyis/ /mthar byed pa las nges par rgyal/ /drang srong lhas bsten ⑩dam pas 'dod/ /lam rnying bzang po rig don 'di/ /phyi rol dmangs rigs bud med gzugs/ /'dzin pas rigs ldan gsum 'di spangs—/ /'di la gang yod gzhan la yod/ /'di la gang med 'ga' la 'ang min—/ /chos la sogs pa bzhi po yang / /de nyid gzhan na'ang mthong ba min/ /gtan tshigs smra bas gtan tshigs kyis/ /lam gsum po ni sun 'byen te/ /rjes su dpag pa gtsor gyur phyir/ /rang gi lugs ni gsal byed gang / /58—74

long ba rkang ①pa'i tshod dpags kyis/ /nyam nga'i lam du rgyug pa ltar/ /rjes su dpag pa gtsor 'dzin rnams/ /lhang bar dka' ba ma yin no/ /'di na ②'ga' yang kun mkhyen med/ /gang phyir 'di ni ma mthong phyir/ /thams cad mkhyen par sangs rgyas la/ /brtags pa 'jig rten gus bya'i phyir/ /sangs rgyas gsung yang tshad ma min/ /byas pa'i phyir na gzhan bzhin no/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kun mkhyen min/ /skyes bu yin phyir gzhan bzhin no/ /sangs rgyas gsung ni tshad ma yinadze+e/ /lta ba gsum po sun 'byen phyir/ /ji ltar gang smra de de ltar/ /gcer bur rgyu ba'i lta ba bzhin/ /sgra don rigs dupa shes pa yis/ /phyogs su lta ba'i dug spangs nas/ /yang dag ji bzhin tshol ⑤byed na/ /'di la 'di ltar dpyad par bya/ /brgyud nas 'ongs pas ma chad pa/ /lung nyid yin pas lung zhe na/ /kun byi lung yang 'grub 'gyur bsaske/ /nges par gang gi de nyid bzung / /gal te rigs pas brtag rjobazod pa'i/ /tshig gang yin pa de lung yin/ /re zhig de nyid dpyad par bya/ /phyi nas de yis sdegang bstan pa'o/ /de la de yi gnyen po'i phyir/ /ye shes grol ba zhes 'dod de/ /nad kyi gnyen po yin pa'i phyir/ /sman gyis ⑧nad las grol ba nyid/ /bya bas grol ba 'thob pa min/ /bya ba yin phyir zhing las bzhin—/ /blo ma yin phyir brjod bya'i phyir/ /cung zad dus can yin phyir yang / /skyes bu'i tshig ni skyon bcas phyir/ /tshad ma min par 'dod ce na/ /gser tog ⑨shes sogs tshig ⑩rnams kyis/ /gtan tshigs nyid ni ma nges 'gyur—/ /'on te byas pa min pa'i phyir/ /rig byed tshad mar sgrub ⑪ce na/ /gtan tshigs thun mong min nyid dang / /ma grub pa yi don yang yin/ /rjes 58—75

su bstan min ①skyon med do/ /zhe na sangs rgyas kyi'ang ma byas/ /sngon gyi sangs rgyas rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /ji ltar rtogs de gsal byas yin/ /byas pa nyid du rjes dpag pas/ /phyogs la rjes su dpag pas gnod/ /byed pa mi dran ma grub pas/ /gtan tshigs 'di ni ma grub nyid/ /gal te sngags kyi byed po sngon/ /sngags dang bcas par byung ④gyur pas/ /byed pos byas kyang ma byas par/ /khyod kyi bstan bcos mngon 'dod pa/ /de dang lhan cig byung bcas phyir/ /skye ba dran pas smras pa bzhin/ /bstan bcos byed po dang bcas na/ /'di ltar ci phyir smra mi byed/ /rtogs dang rjes su mthun phyir ram//de bzhin yi ge'i lugs ldan phyir/ /rig byed tshig rnams gzung bya ba'i/ /byed po skyes bu min nam ci/ /'dis kyang rig byed tshig rnams ni/ /skyes bus byas pa yin par 'dod/ /brjod 'dod don gyi blo skye ba'i/ /rgyu phyir 'dod pa spyod pa bzhin/ /skyes ①bu mi bzang bas byas par/ /rig byed 'di ni gzhal bya ste/ /'byung po 'tshe dudang chang 'thung brdzunarjo/ /smra phyir ma ga'i bstan bcos bzhin/ /gal te gnod sems mi 'dod pa'i/ /'bras bu mi sbyin 'dod pa'i 'byin/ /sngags kyis rjogazung phyir dug spyod bzhin/ /bstan bcos 'byung phyir sbyin pa bzhin/ /sngags sogs phye mas bkug pa yi/ /bgrod min la yang bgrod bya gang / /sngar bstan chang btung phyi ma yang / /des na ma nges pa nyid yin/ /blo sngon ma song bya ba yis/ /dug zos na yang 'chi byed la/ /las ni blo sngon ma song la/ /'bras bu 'byin par ma bstan to//de nyid phyir na dug gi dpe/ /mthun pa min pas rigs ldan min/ /des na sngags kyis phyugs dze+egasod pa/ /rigs ⑧pa min par rtogs ⑨par bya/ /tshe yi 58—76

bar du gcod byed phyir/ /sngags kyis ①gzung ba 'dod pa yi/ /'bras bu 'byen par mi 'dod de/ /dug mtshon bstan bcos sbyor ba bzhin/ /rang gi lugs las bstan ce na/ /'khor ba sgrol byed pa'i yang 'grub/ /thun mong gtan tshigs smra zhe na/ /gzhan la ma grub pa nyid yin/ /gang yang sngags kyis ma bzung ②ba'i/ /bsod nams cung zhig ci byas pa/ /de kun 'bras bu med 'gyur ba/ /mi 'dod pa yi 'bras she na/ /sngags kyis gzhan ni gsod pa gang / /de yang skyon med thal bar 'gyur/ /dbang du byed pa'i sngags gang gis/ /gzhan gyi bud med bsten pa dang / /sngags kyi stobs kyis 'tshe 'gyur gang / /gal te gsod par mi 'dod na/ /gzhan gyi nor ni rku byed pa//de yang skyon bcas ma yin 'gyur/ /gal te sngags sngon song ④ba'i las/ /der ni dger 'dod gzhan ma yin/ /zhe na lung 'di 'dra ba la/ /gtan tshigs khyad par smra dgos so/ /gal te srog chags sngags rjobatab pas/ /gang yang bcing ba ma byas la/ /g.yo ba med par bya zhe na/ /de lta na yang khyad par med/ /gang phyir sgo kun bsubs nas ni/ /bzung nas nus med byol song dag /mtshon cha rnon pos gsod pa la/ /de la sngags kyis ci zhig bya//rang nyid rang byung gyur pa yis/ /mchod sbyin don du byel song bskyed/ /des na de la dgos pa'i phyir/ /mchod sbyin chos yin 'di ltar dper⑦/ /bram ze'i don du 'tshe byed pa/ /'di ltar chos min min pa bzhin/ /mchod sbyin byol song rnams rjogatses kyang / /'bras bu mi 'dod min de yi/ /don ⑦phyir zhe na bram ze'i phyir/ /ci ltar 'dod par ⑧'tshe byed bzhin/ /byol song spyad pa'i phyir bskyed de/ /spyad bya yin phyir bud med bzhin/ /de phyir 58—77

mchod sbyin phyir ma grub/ /byol song gtan tshigs ma grub phyir/ /dbus ①kyi mchog sbyin gnas bsad na'ang / /ma 'khrul bsams bzhin bsad pa'i phyir/ /phyi mar byed po mi 'dod pa'i/ /'bras bur gyur ②te gzhan bzhin no/ /mchod sbyin la ni bsad ①pa yang / /mi 'dod pa yi 'bras bu 'byung / /bsams bzhin du ni srog 'chad pa'i/ /sdug bsngal bskyed phyir gzhan bzhin no//bya ba ji ltar byas pa las/ /de 'dra'i 'bras bu lus la mthong / /byed po de 'dra'i ma mthong yang / /bsad pa yin phyir gzhan bzhin no/ /myos 'gyur btung sogs kyang bshad pas/ /ci ltar bstan bzhin spang bya ste/ /des na stsos 'gyur bsten ⑦mi bya/ /myos par 'gyur phyir stsos sogs bzhin/ /mchod sbyin sngags kyis yongs bzung ba'i/ /myos 'gyur skyon med ma yin te/ /myos phyir dper na gzhan bzhin te/ /sngags kyis btab pa mthong ba bzhin/ /rtags ni mthong ba med ces te/ /gal te mtho ris sogs mi ⑤nges/ /she na rtags las rjes dpag des/ /nges pas nges pa min rjonam ci/ /lan cig 'jug phyir zhes bya 'dir/ /mar me'ang lan cig nyid 'jug pas/ /gtan tshigs ma nges nyid yin ⑦phyir/ /sgra yi rtag pa nyid kyang brdzun/ /yod phyir sgra ni mi rtag ste/ /ci phyir bya ba bzhin mi bzung / /yang na lus kyi g.yo ba bzhin//blo yi rgyu phyir nyams par 'gyur/ /goms phyir phyis shes phyir zhes pa'ang / /gtan tshigs rjes 'gro med pa nyid/ /goms dang phyis kyang shes pa ni/ /rtag min nam yang ma mthong phyir/ /sgra nyid rtag pa nyid ma grub/ /sgra nyid dpe yang ma yin la/ /mngon par gsal byed pa yang bkag /'di ni ngag gi gsal byed min/ /gal te sgra de mnyan bya ⑧na/ /ngag gis gsal bar ji ltar 58—78

'dod—/ /rtogs pa zhes bya'ang brda ①nyid pas/ /'di nyid sgra ru thal bar 'gyur—/ /dang po brda ni med pa na/ /rtogs pa yod ④par mi rigs so/ /'khor ba thog ma med pa ltar/ /brda yang rjes su 'jug pa nyid/ /rjes su dpag pa'i tshad ma nyid/ /de bdag nyid las tha dad min/ /des na tshad ma yin phyir zhes/ /bya ba'i gtan tshigs 'di ma nges/ /tha dad spyod yul can gyi blo'i/ /rgyu nyid du ni khyod kyi de/ /ma grub tha dad yul yin ①phyir/ /gtan tshigs ma grub nyid du 'gyur/ /du ma'i don dngos tha dad phyir/ /don gcig min pa rtogs pa'i rgyu/ /rjes su dpag par yang 'dod pas/ /de phyir sgra byung las gzhan min/ /rtags rjodang 'byel ba rjom mthong bas mthong ba'i don las rjes dpag nyid/ /gang phyir rtog bya rtogs par byed/ /de phyir de ma thag tu min/ /rjes dpag sgra byung tha dad min/ /shog gyur shes pa'i rgyu nyid yin/ /'byel pa dran la ltos bcas duphyir/ /ji ltar rjes dpag rang nyid bzhin/ /sngon med bya bas gsal mi byed/ /sgra yis ⑦gsal byed bkag pa bzhin/ /gsal bar ⑧byas pa'i bum pa ltar/ /sngon med pa yang mi rtag 'dod—/ /zla ba'i btung sogs bya ba'i 'bras/ /rtag pa min pa nyid du 'dod—/ /bya ba'i 'bras bu yin phyir dper/ /'dod pa'i rgyus byung 'bras bu bzhin/ /zla ba'i btung sogs bya ba yis⑨/ /thar pa 'thob ⑩par mi rigs te/ /bya ba yin phyir 'dod pa yi⑪/ /rgyu mtshan bya ba mi 'dod ltar/ /de'i phyir lam 'di la brten nas/ /mthar byed las rgyal 'gyur ma yin/ /blo yis dpyod pa'i nus med pas/ /gzhan rjes 'brang bas 'di la brten/ /'chi med nyid ni yod pa'i phyir/ /nyer zhi rig byed yod ce na/ /med de 'di 58—79

ni phyin ci log /mi rtag pa la rtag par btags/ / rig las 'byung ①ba'i don gsum mo/ /shis brjod bstod dang cho ga dag /gang phyir don 'di gsum po 'dis/ /thar pa nam yang 'thob ma yin/ /gal te snying po sdenyid yin pas/ /rig byed tshad mar 'dod ce na/ /mi shes phyin ci log lta sogs/ /ci yi phyir na tshad ma min/ /lan ①gsum po ni ston byed pa/ /tshangs pa khyab 'jug bde byed rnams/ /nyon mongs bdag nyid spyod mthong bas/ /gang phyir gsum 'di spang ba'i rigs/ /'dod pa med na ji ltar 'di/ /'dod dga' ma la spyod par byed/ /de bzhin 'dod bral lha mo la/ /'gro gtso stobs kyis duci phyir brjod/ /'di ni skye dgu'i bdag las skyes/ /de ni rang byung bu yin na/ /rang byung tsha mo 'dod ldan la/ /spyad par gyur pa min nam ci—/ /rig las drang srong skye bstan pa/ /'di ltar byung 'di brtag ⑤mi bya/ /gnyis skyes rnams kyi gsang ba gang / /kun la brjod par bya ba min/ /rang byung gi ni spyod pa 'di/ /'khrul par gyur pa 'di la ltos/ /tsha mo mthong dang reg pa las/ /byol song bzhin du gang chags nas/ /lus ni 'byung bar gyur pa las/ /mi gtsang shong dubar gyur pa 'di/ /mi ni sems dang ldan pa 'ga'//mi skye yin na 'di byed dam/ /khyi dang bong bu dag gi ni/ /spyod pa 'phags pas dmad pa la/ /rang byung spyod pas des na desadze+e/ /de dag dang ni khyad ci yod/ /shes ldan shes pas sdig pa dag /sreg ste me yis shing bzhin no/ /des na mthu yi khyad par rmis⑧/ /ngan 'gror de mi 'gro zhe na/ /gang gis nyon mongs sreg nus pa'i/ /mkhas pa shes des shes ldan la/ /de ni sdig pa byed mi 'gyur/ /de rgyu shes ldan la med phyir/ /thong bar byed pa'i las 58—80

rnams kyis/ /rnal 'byor grub la mi gos zhes/ /smra zhing yang dag lam nyams la| /gzhan dag gi yang nyams par byed/ /tshangs la sogs pas de nyid don| / blo yis ①mthong bar mi 'dod de/ /tshangs pa dang ni rtse gsum can//thig le mchog mar kun chags phyir/ /dang por khro sdemes ma bsregs na/ /grong khyer sum rtseg ①ji ltar bsregs/ /nyi rgyal so phyung rjoci lta bu/ /nyi skal mig phyung ci lta bu/ /tshangs bsad chang 'thungs 'dod pa can/ /dbang phyug de nyid mthong zhe na/ /de yi lam gyi rjes 'brang ba/ /ji ltar de nyid mi mthong 'gyur—/ /khyab 'jug yin na sgra gcan dang / /tsa tu ra dang dmyal la sogs//snying rje med par gyur pa yi/ /nor srog phral ba ji lta rjobu/ /gzhan nor chung ma ma byen len/ /chang sred srog ni gcod pa dang / /de nyid mthong bas 'ongs dhigyur na/ /ri brags rkun mo shin tu'ang yin/ /skye dgu bskyang la gsal ba'i phyir/ /lha min lha yi tsher ma dag /bsad kyang skyon ni yod min te//de ni chos bsrung phyir zhe na/ /gal te de ni chos bsrung bar/ /'dod pa yin na ci yi phyir/ /gzhan nor bud med rku ⑦ba dang / /g.yo sgyu ④la 'jug spong mi byed/ /'gro ba'i de nyid de rang bzhin/ /rang bzhin yin phyir dong tshe bzhin—/ /'gro ba mi rtag par mthong na/ /de ni ji ltar rtag par 'dod/ /gal te 'gro las de gzhan ⑨te/ /sa dang rdza mkhan bzhin zhe na/ /rdza mkhan dang ni sa bzhin du/ /mi rtag par ni mtshon par bya/ /chos min 'dod pa ma yin na/ /de byed par ni ji ltar 'gyur/ /yang na sgog tu gyur pa'i don/ /mi shes phyir na byas pa yin/ /sred pas 'jig rten skyong ⑩zhe na/ /sred pa'i bran du ji ltar 'os/ /snying rje zhe na 'jig rten rnams/ /sgyu mas rmongs par 58—81

ci phyir byed/ /skye dang 'chi sogs sdug bsngal can/ /lha ma yin la 'ang cis mi brtse/ /thams cad mnyam par mthong ba'i phyir/ /dgra yi 'du shes mi rigs so/ /rang nyid 'gro ba'i byed po yin/ /skye 'jig dag gi gtso bo ni/ /phan par byed la brtse ba ①ltar/ /phan byed la brtse de ci ltar/ /gal te 'gro gtso 'di yin pas/ /'di las lhag pa'i mchog med na/ /ci phyir mdangs ldan ma bcas pas/ /thub pa gos ngan khur bar byed/ /yang na de yi spyod mthong nas/ /skye dgu byed po zhes bya'i blo/ /rang gis ②byas sam slob yin na'ang / /khur bar byed pa'i blo ci yin/ /mchod 'os dka' thub lhag ce na/ /dka' thub gtso yin de ma yin/ /dmod pas 'jigs pa yin zhe na/ /byed po yin pa'i yon tan ci/ /'dod chags zhe sdang sogs 'dres pa'i/ /'phrog byed spyod pa 'di ci yin/ /'phags min spyod pa 'di ldan pa/ /de ni ji ltar skyes mchog yin/ /'gro ba mnyam med 'phrog byed pa/ /gal te de la stobs yod na/ /ci phyir shugs can nag po yis/ /'jigs nas phug tu zhugs zhes drag /shugs can nag pos 'jigs skrag ①nas/ /rgyal po'i drang srong mu tsu ku'i/ /khri yi 'og tu zhugs gyur par/ /nag por gyur pa min nam ci/ /grong khyer mang por gnas pa na/ /khung nas rkun mo bzhin 'bros pa/ /gal te srid gsum des bskyed na/ /lha ma yin la ci phyir 'jigs/ /gang tshe rgas byed mdas phog nas/ /'di ni 'chi bar 'gyur ba'i tshe/ /de nyid mthong ba'i shes pa dang / /de yi rjostobs kyang gang du song / /sgyu dang g.yo yis rmongs byas te/ /ngan pa'i las la sbyar byas nas/ /bla ma gnyen bsad 'jigs pa yis/ /srid sgrub tu gyur ji lta bu/ /dgra tshogs zad par byas pa la⑤/ /58—82

nges par rang la nus med pas/ /gang phyir snying rje med pas gzhan/ /bskul ba'i don du song bar gyur/ /gang yang cung zhig dbang phyug ldan/ /gal te de la gnas yin na/ /de ni kun la khyab nyid min/ /des na gzhung 'di dor bar gyis/ /'og tu zhugs nas sa bteg pa/ /khyab pa yin na ji ltar rung / /'on te 'di der ma gnas na'ang / /khyab par smra ba mi mdzes so / /'og tu zhugs nas sa 'dzin par/ /nus na drang srong dmod pa yis/ /rang rigs sa 'og 'gro gyur pa/ /'dzin par mi byed ji lta bu/ /de la gus pa mi nyams zhes/ /gang la de lta'i blo yod na/ /de la gus pa'i bud med dgaco bzung dgras khyer ji lta bu/ /de 'ba' zhig kyang ma yin rmi/ /bshes dang gnyen dang bu rnams dang / /de la gus par mthong ba gzhan/ /kun kyang nyams par gyur pa nyid/ /'phrog byed 'di yi dngos gzhan zhig /zhi bar gal te rtog byed la/ /gang mthong dul gang yang srid du/ /'byung bar mi 'gyur gang yin pa/ /'di yi yod min med ma yin/ /yod min med pa min pa'ang min/ /des na med phyir yod pa'i phyir/ /yod med min phyir de ni mchog /nya sogs ngo bo yod pa'i phyir/ /gzhan yin na yang 'chi med min/ /gzhan min nyid na'ang gzhan min phyir/ /de ni zhi min gzhan bzhin no/ /gal te gcig ni zhi bdag nyid/ /yin na'ang gcig ni ma zhi na/ /bud med 'phyon ma'ang bsngags par 'os/ /lus kyi byed ni 'dod pa'i phyir/ /yod sogs sgra yis brjod min phyir/ /mchog ces bya ba'ang rigs pa min/ /yod na mchog tu rigs 'gyur la/ /rgyu nyid du yang rigs pa yin/ /rgyu nyid yin pa spangs pa yin/ /gzhan nyid yin pa'ang snga ma bzhin/ /rgyu yang ma 58—83

yin gzhan yang min/ /'chi med ma yin skye ba'ang min/ /gal te 'chi med dngos yin na/ /'di ni nyams 'gyur ro sogs bzhin/ /gal te 'chi med dngos min na/ /de med nam mkha'i me tog bzhin/ /yod min med min mi rigs te/ /me la grang dang dro bzhin no/ /de bzhin 'chi ba med pa delda/brjod med yin par ji ltar rigs/ /brjod du med nyid bdag dang ni/ /'dra na med yin bkag pa nyid/ /'chi med phyir 'chi med ce na/ /'chi med med phyir 'chi med min/ /skyon rnams sba phyir btags pa yi/ /de yi dngos po gzhan zhig ste/ /de la dmigs na ji lta bu/ /grol 'dod grol bar 'gyur ba yin/ /tshangs pa dang ni nor lha yis/ /glur blangs gsang ba oṃ zhes bya/ /tshangs pa'i yi ge de nyid ni/ /yod de kun la khyab pa yin/ /de ni tshad gsum gsal ba yin/ /de bzhin shin tu phra bar bstan/ /dang po'i rgyu ni yi ge aḥ①/ /ngag dang snying stobs ①sa me bsdusarjo/ /las dang nam mkha' nyid dag kyang / /yid rtul dusnying stobs u dang ldan/ /byed po'i yi ge ma'i ming can/ /srog dang mun pa gsum pa yin/ /'gro ba thams cad sdud par byed/ /gnyid chen shin tu log pa'i rgyu'o/ /'pho dang bsam gtan rlung 'byung 'jug /gzung bar bya dang brtag pa dang / /ting 'dzin zhes bya rnal 'byor gyi/ /yan lag drug tu brjod pa rjoyin/ /dbang po kun kyi shes pa ni/ /yul la g.yo bar byed pa rnams/ /yang dag bsdus la srog ldan ni⑦/ /yid la bsam gtan bya ba ste/ /gnas dag tu ni spo zhi bya/ /dbang po dag dang dbang don dag /rus sbal yan lag bzhin bsdus la/ /dran pas yi ge oṃ brjod na/ /de gus skyes bu grol bar 'gyur/ /58—84

'phrog byed gus pas grol bar ①ni/ /'phrog byed mthong bas mi rigs nyid/ /rnam rtog mtshan ma dang bcas phyir/ /dper na 'phrog byed mthong ba bzhin/ /grol phyir rnal 'byor ldan pa yi/ /mi rtog ④blo yang mi 'dod de/ /mtshan mar 'dzin phyir brdzun yin na/ /yongs su brtags pa smos ci dgos/ /chags sogs kun tu spyod pa'i phyir/ /tshangs sogs rnams ni phyugs rdzi bzhin/ /de nyid rig pa spangs pa'i phyir/ /rgyu la mkhas pa ma yin no/ /bden pa'i chos ni bstan pa'am/ /rang nyid sgrub par byed pa yis/ /chos ni bsrungs par 'gyur yin na①/ /de la 'di ni gnyi ga med/ /kun kyang bskyed pa'i rgyu nyid du/ /smra la rang bdag tha dad padu/ /gang gi tshig la bden pa'am/ /mi bden par ni brtag par bya/ /de gcig phyir ⑤skyon med ce na/ /tshangs pas tshangs bsad ji lta bu/ /gcig nyid rab tu bkag pa'i phyir/ /gcig nyid yin par mi rigs so/ /bdag las dbye ba mi rigs rjopas/ /gsum nyid du yang ji ltar 'gyur/ /sdug bsngal rgyu la rmongs rnams la/ /de zhi'i gtam ⑦yang ga la yod—/ /rig las rnal 'byor bstan pa ni/ /de bstan pa las nyams pa'i phyiraske/ /chos bsrung bar ni nus pa yi/ /re zhig chos bden smra mi nus/ /sgrub pa las ni nyams pa'i phyir/ /gzhan dag zhi bar khrid ④mi nus/ /ji ltar g.yang sar rang lhung ba/ /gzhan dag 'dren par mi nus so/ /rtog pa'i dra bas btags pa yi/ /log pa'i gtan tshigs gsum po la/ /rigs sam mi rigs dpyad nas ni/ /gsum po 'di ni gtang ba'i rigs/ /sna tshogs byed pa byed ⑨byed sogs/ /rigs ⑩pa min ⑪pas sngar smras so/ /byed po yin par bden nyid na/ /'di dag gis ni ci zhig byas/ /re zhig bdag ni ma skyes 58—85

phyir—/ /de yis byas par mi 'dod do/ /chos dang chos min des ma babyed/ /de'i yon tan phyir da lta bzhin/ /gal te 'di dag byed pos ①yin/ /las kyis ①bya ba'i ma yin na/ /las dang bya ba de dag gis/ /rgyu dang 'bras bu ji ltar 'gyur/ /bde dang sdug bsngal nyer dmigs pa'i/ /lus kyang de dag la 'jug pas/ /des na lus can rnams kyi lus/ /dbang phyug sogs kyis ①byas mi rigs/ /bskal pa dang po'i lus can lus/ /sngon rjobyas ma mthong rgyu can te/ /bde sogs 'byung ba'i rgyu yin phyir/ /dper na da ltar lus bzhin no—/ /gal te dbang phyug gi ⑤dbang phyug /de yang bsod nams byas she na//de yang bsod nams gzhan dbang phyir/ /dbang phyug dbang phyug min par 'gyur—/ /gal te dbang phyug gi dbang phyug /glo bur gyur par 'dod na ni//des na gzhan dang mtshungs pa'i phyir/ /dbang phyug dbang phyug min par 'gyur//dbang phyug shes dngos yin zhe na/ /des na des byas 'gro ba rnams/ /rgyu yi rjes su byed pa'i phyir/ /kun kyang sems dang ldan par 'gyur/ /gal te dbang phyug rgyu yin na/ /'gro ba phra sogs ldan par 'gyur/ /las byed dbang phyug yin zhe na/ /de yang dmyal ba dag tu 'tshed/ /de min gzhan dag 'tshed na ni/ /byas nyams ma byas 'phrad par 'gyur/ /thar pa med pa yang yin te/ /rtag tu sdug bsngal rgyu ldan phyir/ /de yi sdug bsngal ga la zhi/ /me ni 'bar bar gyur pa yi/ /tsha ba ma zhi mthong ba bzhin/ /gcig pu sna tshogs min zhe na/ /'bras bu sna tshogs ji lta bu/ /'dod pas sna tshogs yin zhe na 'ang / /gcig pu sna tshogs mi rigs so/ /rtag pa cha med phra ba dang / /'gro ba'i byed po gcig pu nyid/ /kun la khyab pa yin no lo/ /'di las 58—86

mtshar ba gzhan ci yod/ /phan tshun za bas 'jigs pa yi/ /bde ba rnyed dka'i dud 'gro dang / /zhib tu 'thag ①cing gcod 'bigs pa'i/ /sdug bsngal gyis gzir dmyal ba dang / /mi rnams skye rga nad dag dang / /sdug bsngal zug rngu'i rma btod nas/ /dga' 'gyur gang yin drag po zhes/ /ming don ldan pa de phyag 'tshal/ /'dzin pa can gang nor ldan dang / /gzhan gyi mtsho sdebacas dge ba can/ /chos min can 'ga' mtho gnas ④ldan/ /dbang phyug spyod par gsal ba yin/ /yon tan nor ldan tshe thung dang / /ngan par spyod rnams tshe ring dang / /gtong ldan dbul po mthong bas na/ /dbang phyug gis byas gsal ba yin/ /kha cig sangs rgyas pa yang bde/ /de la gus pa kha cig sdug /dbang phyug bkas ni bsod nams can/ /dag kyang ci phyir sdig mi dubyed/ /sna tshogs las la mi shes pas/ /de rgyu nyid du smra ba yin/ /sna tshogs byed por tshangs pa ni/ /mi rigs ⑤sngon du bstan pa bzhin/ /tshangs pa byed por bden na yang / /de yis 0ci zhig byas par 'gyur/ /dang por sems ni mnyam bzhag dze+epas/ /blo yi sgo rnams legs bsdams la/ /yid la shi ba gzhag ⑧par bya/ /'di ltar yi ge oṃ bsgoms te/ /snying la gzungs kyis bzung byas pa/ /sa sogs gzugs la goms par bya/ /bde byed mnyes na sdug bsngal las/ /grol 'gyur zer ba 'di mi bden/ /ci srid yid kyi shes 'byung bas—/ /de srid grol bar mi rigs te/ /yid shes 'byung phyir ji ltar sngar/ /grol bar ma gyur pa bzhin no/ /dbang phyug la gus grol 'gyur bar/ /mi rigs bde byed mthong ba yang / /dmigs la gnas pa yin pa'i phyir/ /dper na mtho yor mthong ba bzhin/ /sdug bsngal rgyu ni dbang phyug na/ /de 58—87

ni rtag phyir bcos su med/ /des na sdug bsngal mthar ①'gro bar/ /dbang phyug nam yang 'gyur ma yin/ /'dis ni lhag ma'ang dgag byas phyir/ /tshangs pa khyab 'jug bdag smra la/ /mi rigs phyir na dbang phyug sogs/ /btags la blo ni dga' mi byed/ /dus chen shin tu mang po 'das/ /bud med sems ni shin tu g.yo/ /de phyir bram ze zhes bya'i ②rigs/ /'ga' yang gang la'ang yod ma yin/ /rtsal dang rtsal gyi sde dag dang / /de bzhin thos pa'i rtsa can dag /drang srong chen po go ta ma/ /bran song nyal ba'i mngal nas skyes/ /gzhung ni rtsom par byed pa yi/ /kun 'da' ④bram ze'i drang srong yang / /thub pa chen po dutun 'da' yisadu/ /gdol pa mo dang nyal las skyes//nya pa yi ni bu mo la/ /pha ni mchog 'gro zhes bya bas/ /nyal las drang srong gling lam skyes/ /de yang bram ze zhes brjod do/ /bram ze'i drang srong 'jig rten grags/ /thos mang rig 0byed 'don byed pa/ /drang srong rwa zhes bya ba'i ma—/ /dud 'gror skyes pa'i ri dwags yin/ /spom dang de bzhin ras ⑦bal can—/ /dmangs rigs bu yin bram zer grags/ /zla ba'i btung ba yang 'thungs nas/ /'jig rten drang srong chen por grags/ /'jig rten du ni grags gyur pa/ /bram ze lung phu ⑧zhes bya ba/ /thos mang de yang gdol pa'i rigs—/ /lung ma ⑨zhes bya ba las skyes/ /bur shing bu mo las skyes pa'i/ /drang srong drang srong ka na nga / /ka na ya yi rigs bcas pa/ /skyes pa yin zhes rjod par byed/ /drang srong ka pi ⑪dza la yang / /drang srong dbang byed chen po yis⑫/ /gdol pa phreng ba mo la ni/ /nyal las skyes pa yin zhes thos/ /a gasta ⑫dang dbang byed ni/ /bum pa'i nang nas skyes zhes thos/ /bum 58—88

pa'ang bum pa'i nang nas skyes/ /de bzhin gtsang skyes chu las ①skyes/ /pad+ma'i 'dab las shes rab myur/ /ka bad t+ya ni thal ba las/ /mgo la thod pa can nyid ni/ /thod pa las ni skyes zhes zer/ /chu yis ②sdig pa dag pa 'khrul/ /dge sogs nyo tshong byed pa dag /nyes bstan gsum la mthong bas na/ /gang phyir gsum 'di gtong ①ba'i rigs/ /'dis ni sdig pa dag mi 'gyur/ /ma reg phyir dang ma mthong phyir/ /ma bsgoms phyir dang bag chags phyir/ /dran pa'i shes dang dge ba bzhin/ /pad snying rkang phyung ④klung sogs kyi/ /chus ni sdig pa 'dag mi 'gyur/ /reg bya'i phyir ram bsgo bya'i phyir/ /khyim gyi ngan skyugs chu bzhin no/ /rang bzhin bsod nams ma yin las/ /chur zhugs sogs kyis zad ⑤'gyur na/ /'bab dhistegs sogs su khrus byas rnams//sdug bsngal mi 'gyur rgyu med phyir/ /las rnams zad pa'ang ⑦ma yin pas/ /sdog pa zad pa 'ga' yang med/ /nang ⑧gi bdag nyid mi 'dag ces/ /bstan pa yod pas de yang brdzun/ /rgyud gzhan las ni rgyud gzhan du/ /sdig pa 'pho ⑨ba min par bzung / /lus can min phyir 'dod chags dang / /zhe sdang gti mug mi 'pho bzhin/ /de tshe bsod nams blangs par ni/ /mi rigs zhes ni nges par bya/ /sems dang mtshungs par ldan pa'i phyir/ /dper na bde dang sdug bsngal bzhin/ /'bar sogs nang du mchongs ⑩pa nyid//tshangs pa'i 'jig rten sogs 'gro bar/ /bstan pa'i lugs ngan gsum las mthong / /de phyir spang bar rigs ⑪pa yin/ /mer mchong ⑫la sogs tshangs pa yi/ /'jig rten sogs 'thob rgyu ma yin/ /srog la gnod par byed pa'i phyir—/ /phye ma leb sogs mthong ba bzhin/ /bza' dang btung ba spangs pa 58—89

yis—/ /mtho ris thob⑥par mi 'dod de/ /bkres dang skom pa'i rgyu yin phyir/ /zas ma zos pas gdungs pa bzhin/ /zas ma zos sogs bsod nams 'gyur/ /spangs phyir sdig spangs bzhin zhe na/ /bden sogs spangs pas gtan tshigs 'di—/ /ma nges pa nyid yin par 'gyur/ /zas spangs bsod nams mi 'gyur te/ /bya ba de la sdig med phyir/ /dge ba yid la byed pa yi/ /yid la byed pa spangs pa bzhin/ /mtha' gsum dag pa'i sha gang dag /zos kyang sdeg tu mi 'gyur te/ /dngas ma sogs su 'gyur ba'i phyir/ /slong mo'i zas la sdig med bzhin/ /gang yang sha ni zos pa yis/ /sdig pa'i rgyur ni mi 'gyur te/ /bkres pa zlog ①pa'i rgyu yin phyir/ /ma blangs byen pa'i zas skom bzhin—/ /sha ni mi bza' ①ba yin phyir/ /mi za zhe na lus la rtogs/ /sa bon dang ni brtan dubyed pa/ /mi gtsang ⑤mi gtsang srin rjobu bzhin/ /khu ⑦ba sogs las byung ba'i phyir/ /nya sha sogs ni smad ④ce na/ /mar dang 'o sogs rgyu yin pas/ /'di ni ma nges pa nyid yin/ /sha za srog ⑨gcod nyid yin te/ /de yi rgyu mtshan phyir zhe na/ /lpags sogs thogs pas gtan tshigs ni/ /ma nges pa nyid yin par 'gyur/ /'jal dang srang la g.yo byed dang / /nye bar 'dod pa mi dge mnyam/ /'tsho byed nor ni rnyed pa de'i/ /gang yang sdig pa dag las ni/ /skyon ni gnyis kyis ⑩lhag pa ru/ /nyo ba po la 'byung bar 'dod/ /de bzhin bud med bdag po gzhan/ /'dod pa'i kha zas sbyin byed dang / /skal bar ldan pa'i bud med dang / /gang dag chos de ston pa dang / /tshul khrims med la smod ⑪pa dang / /skyon tshogs 'joms phyir ti ti ri/ /dgra gsos las kyang nges par ni/ /chos ma yin pa thob par 'gyur/ /kun 58—90

dga' ra ba khron pa rdzing / /der ni lus can shi gyur na/ /byed pa'i skye mched yin pa'i phyir/ /de la skyon 'di yod par 'gyur/ /gsad bya yod pas gsod yod kyis/ /gang phyir med na ma yin no/ /des na gsad bya gsod pa gnyis/ /sdig pa mnyam par thob par 'gyur/ /mthong dang thos dang bsnams pa dang / /reg dang dran pa nyid dang ni/ /sha las byas na 'ang chos min 'byel/ /'di lta bur ni 'gyur ba yin/ /gsal bar byed pa'i nyi ma dang / /skye ba'i rgyu yi pha dag dang / /skyong ①bar byed pa'i mi bdag rnams/ /de rnams sdig pa'i byed po nyid/ /gos byed pa yi ltar byas na//zas kyi bya ba'ang mi rigs te/ /gang phyir skyon ni gnyis 'byung ba/ /ma zos pa la ma yin te/ /zos las srog chags skye 'gyur zhing / /de dag thur du 'byung bar 'gyur/ /skyes pa nyams gyur ma zos na/ /ma skyes skye bar mi 'gyur ro/ /gal te gzhan kyi rgyu mtshan gyi/ /skyon de khyod ni mi 'dod na/ /gzhan gyis bsad par gyur pa yi/ /sdig de spyod la ga la 'ong / /gang phyir mi sdig gnas ①mi sbyin/ /des na sdig de yod ma yin/ /de phyir sha sogs rjes gnang ba/ /skyon med par ni gzung bar bya/ /sha za ba ni skyon bcas min/ /de tshe srog chags gnod min phyir/ /mu tig rma bya'i sgo sogs dang / /'bras dang chu yi dgos pa bzhin/ /'dod chags kun rtog las byung phyir/ /sha zos de yi rgyu ma yin/ /de ma zos la'ang de 'byung ste/ /rtswa zan ba lang la sogs bzhin| /sems med pa yi brtan pa la'ang / /sems ni yod par rtogs byed pa'i/ /nyes bstan gsum la mthong bas na/ /gsum po 'di ni spang ba'i rigs/ /ljon shing sems dang bcas pa min/ /skye gnas bzhir ni ma 58—91

bsdus phyir/ /dkyil du bcad kyang bzod pa'i phyir/ /phag dum bzhin du bems po yin/ /gal te srog chags rkang brgya ltar/ /reg na 'khums ①par 'gyur bas na/ /sa ma ga dang thal sbyar ni/ /sems dang bcas par 'dod ce na/ /me yis reg pa'i skra sogs dang / /skra la 'tshal ⑦phyes blugs pa yi/ /khyad par de dag nyid kyis kyang / /'di ni ma nges pa nyid yin/ /gso ba yod pas shing rnams ni/ /sems dang bcas par mi 'grub ste/ /chang la sogs pa nyams pa ①dag /ldog pa yod par the tshom 'gyur/ /mthun rjopa las skyes 'phel 'gyur dang / /sdang sems dus ldan skye ba'i phyir/ /de bzhin gnyid log smyo ba'i phyir/ /sems yod rta sogs bzhin du 'dod/ /lhog pa byu ru be+e ḍūr+ya/ /rin chen gser kyi myug sogs kyis/ /shing rnams sems dang bcas par ni/ /'di ltar ma nges pa nyid yin/ /'di dag la ni sems med phyir/ /sdang sems zhes bya 'ang ma grub nyid/ /gtan tshigs don yang mi 'grub ste/ /lhog ⑤pa sogs kyis rjom nges nyid/ /sems can rnams kyi las dbang gis/ /rtsa bas 'byung ba dus su skye/ /dmyal ba dang ni mtho ris kyi/ /mtshon dang dpag bsam shing bzhin no/ /lam gsum ji bzhin don ⑦ldan yin/ /tshangs pas bstan phyir sman dpyad bzhin//'das dang ma 'ongs mkhyen pa po/ /des bstan bsgrub bya yin zhe na/ /tshangs smras zhes bya'i gtan tshigs dag /skyed byed sogs kyis smras pa ni/ /nyes par brtags par bsgrubs skepa'i phyir/ /des na khyod kyi ⑨'di ma nges/ /'ga' zhig don bzhin mthong ba ⑩yis/ /kun tu don bzhin ma yin te/ /gnag rdzi smyon pa'i tshig rnams ni/ /kun tu ji bzhin don min bzhin/ /58—92

'das dang ma 'ongs shes pa nyid/ /yi dwags la sogs la yang yod/ /de yis smras pa'i thams cad min/ /de phyir gtan tshigs dbe+ed bya yin/ /chos sogs 'di la gang yod pa/ /de nyid gzhan la'ang yod ces pa/ /res 'ga' srin bu'i yi ge'i tshul/ /legs bshad 'ga' zhig mthong ba yin/ /ji ltar mi gtsang phung po'i nang / /rin chen 'ga' zhig mthong gyur pa/ /rab tu skye dang de yi mthu/ /shes dang ldan pas de shes 'gyur/ /legs bshad 'ga' zhig gsum pa la/ /rab tu mthong ba'ang de dang 'dra/ /khyim srang mi gtsang phung po las/ /rin chen 'byung ba ma yin no/ /skyon med rjes su dpag pa yis| /rigs sam mi rigs ma dpyad par/ /blo ni gzhan gyis bskyed pa'i phyir—/ /lung gzhan dag la the tshom za/ /ji ltar klung chen rgal ①'dod pa/ /gzings dag yongs su 'dzin pa ltar/ /de bzhin gtang ④bya yin na yang / /rjes su dpag pa gzung bar rigs/ /sgra tsam rjes su 'brang byed cing / /song ba'i rjes su 'gro byed pa'i/ /dmus long bzhin du dkyil 'khor 'dir/ /byis pa 'khor bar 'khor ba yin/ /rten pa med pa'i dmus long dag /nyam nga'i lam du 'gro byed ltar/ /sgra tsam gtso bor byed pa rnams/ /rtsang bar dka' ba ma yin no/ /kun mkhyen zhes bya'i sgra 'di yang / /yul 'ga' zhig la ji bzhin yin/ /seng ge'i sgra yang la la bden/ /kha cig nye bar btags pa nyid/ /chos dang sprul pa'i sku dag ni/ /nga la mi nyid du ma grub/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'ang ma grub ste/ /des na ma nges pa nyid yin/ /gal te ji ltar khyod bcom ldan/ /thams cad mkhyen pa min par 'dod/ /bde byed khyab 'jug sogs dag gis/ /shes pa de ltar min zhe na/ /ji ltar de dag 58—93

gis shes ltar/ /thams cad mkhyen pa de bden na/ /rab rib can gyis mthong ba ltar/ /dri med mig gis mi mthong bzhin/ /yang na 'di ltar thams cad mkhyen/ /chog shes nyid du 'dod na ni/ /gang phyir mdze ①ni mi sogs kyis/ /gtan tshigs 'di ni ma nges nyid/ /cung zhig shes kyi kun mi shes—/ /she na thub pas gang ma mkhyen/ /mtho ris byang grol lam zhe na/ /bstan pa 'di las bstan pa nyid/ /bstan du zin kyang mi rigs zhes/ /gal te khyod kyi ④blo 'byung na/ /mi shes pa nyid yin pas na/ /de yi lan yang smras zin to//bstan bcos blo sgra'i phyogs byas kyang / /gtan la dbab par 'dra ba yin/ /dpyad ①pa can sogs ma nges nyid/ /byas pa'i phyir na skyon dang ldan/ /gsum po sun 'byin par 'dra bas/ /gcer bur rgyu ltar bdag 'dod pas/ /bsgrub bya'i rjes su 'gro med phyir/ /dpe ni med pa nyid yin no/ /dbu ma'i snying po las dpyod pa'i de kho na nyid gtan la dbab pa la 'jug pa ste le'u dgu pa'o// //gcer bur rgyu bas thub pa la/ /kun ma bstan pas kun mkhyen min/ /zhes smras khyu mchog sogs ma nges/ /brjod du med par brjod pa'i phyir/ /'khor ba'i thog ma ma rjorig cing / /rgyu yang rab tu ma shes la/ /de phyir ma rig rig med phyir/ /de bzhin nam mkha'i ro bzhin no/ /gal te thub pa'i mthus nus na/ /sems can thams cad mya ngan 'da'/ /mu stegs rnams kyis dhizhag bdun na/ /nor dang phrag dog dag gi phyir/ /mdzes ma bdag gis bsad do zhes/ /rang nyid kyis ni bstan pa yin/ /ji ltar thag pa chad gyur nas/ /shing gshong sa la lhung ba ni/ /rgyal bcas skye bo'i 'khor mthong 58—94

nas| /de dag ngo mtshar che bar gyur/ /mngon du bstan par bya ba'i phyir/ /skyob pas gzhan du de ma bsgyur/ /sā ①la can grong zhugs pa ni/ /sems can don gyi bya ba mdzad/ /gang phyir bdud las rgyal zin pas/ /bdud kyi las ni de na med/ /nyan thos tshogs bcas dpa' bo ni/ /der ni bsod snyoms chad gyur pas/ /sems ni zhum par ma mthong tshe/ /mang po byang chub tu nges ④'gyur/ /glang chen dul bar bya phyir dang / /'gro ba rnams ni gdul ④ba'i phyir/ /bcom ldan grong khyer gshegs pa yin/ /thub pa bcom ldan mi mkhyen min/ /lha sbyin gyes ni sbyogs 'phangs pa/ /de yang 'gro la phan phyir te//gzhan gyi gnod las grol ba yi/ /che ba'i bdag nyid bstan pa yin/ /skyes bu lngas dubargyab brten pa'i rdo/ /chen po 'phangs par gyur pa ni/ /gnod sbyin kim pas de mthong nas/ /rang gi lus la bzed pa yin/ /lha dang lha min rnams dang ni/ /stong phrag dag ni brgya snyed kyis/ /dad pa'i dbang po sogs thob nas/ /srid pa las ni grol bar gyur/ /lhas sbyin khyim na gnas na ni/ /'khor los sgyur ba'i stobs ldan zhing / /'khor dang stobs ni thob gyur nas/ /bstan pa 'di ni nyams par byed/ /blo ngan 'di ni rab byung na/ /nga la ci yang byed mi nus/ /de ltar ston pas gzigs nas ni/ /rab tu byung ba dum bzlog go/ /cho 'phrul dag ni mthong 'gyur zhing / /chos ni thos par gyur nas 'di/ /bsod nams sog dupar gzigs gyur nas/ /rgyu skar bzang po ⑦bzhag pa yin/ /⑧dbu ma'i snying po las thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du grub par bstan pa ste le'u bcu pa'o// //58—95

tha snyad la yang rmongs gyur pa/ /lta ba'i phreng 'khrugs 'gro rnams las/ /gnyis med de nyid nam mkha' 'dra/ /skal ldan sems can bkri phyir dang / /'jig rten gnyis la phan gdags phyir/ /gang gis ①'jig rten kun rdzob ni/ /'jig rten 'das kyang ston mdzad pa/ /'jig rten rig pa de la 'dud/ /de ltar 'di ni dbu ma yi/ /snying po mdor bsdus byas pa yin/ /blo ldan mdo sde du ma yi/ /gzugs brnyan blta ba'i me long yin/ /dbu ma'i snying po las bstod pa dang mtshan bstan pa'i le'u ste bcu gcig pa'o / /snedabu ma'i snying po tshig le'ur byas pa slob dpon chen po bha byas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //ra sa 'phrul snang gi gtsug lag khang gi gzhir/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dī paṃ ka ra shrī dzñā na'i zhal snga nas dang ①/ lots+tsha ba dge slong tshud khrims rgyal bas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o// //58—96

〈〈snar 〉〉kyi/95 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉ris/ ②〈〈snar 〉〉des/ ③〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉toradul/ du〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉skasngas/ du〈〈pe 〉〉〈po ra 〉〉bas/ du〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉bsog ⑦〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉por/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉〉lhag spyod shi bar gyur pa yang //96 ①〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉stan/ ②〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉ska/ // ni〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉wadang /brtsar 'bras re'u migadabu ma/ (32)58wa 103

༄ga /dbu ma'i snying po'i 'grel pa rtog ge 'bar ba ①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ mad dh+yā ma kā ④z-i da ya bṛsbyi ta ra ①kā dzā la—/ bod skad du/ dbu ma'i snying po'i 'grel pa rtog ge 'bar ba bam po dang po/ thams cad mkhyen pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di na rang gi lha yid du 'ong ba la dang por phyag 'tshal ba nye bar bstan pa'i bstan bcos dag ni skyes bu dpa' bo'i rkyen dang / bar chad med pa dang / 'bras bu dang ldan par 'gyur bas/ de'i phyir bstan bcos byed pas bstan bcos kyi dang por/gang gis de nyid rab brtag min/ /rnam shes bya min gzhi ma yin/ /mtshon min brtag min rig bya min/ /skye 'jig med cing bde ba dang / /rnam brtag ma yin snang ba med/ /mtshan ma med cing gsal byed med/ /gnyis min gnyis med ma yin dang / /zhi dang blo 'jug rnam spangs pa/ /yi ge med pa yi ge yis/ /thugs rje nyid kyis bstan mdzad pa/ /ston pa ma nor nyid 58byed104

gsung ba/ /de la gus par phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes ston pa la/ de nyid khyad par thun mong ma yin pa dag ①gis khyad par can ston par mdzad pa nyid kyis mngon par bstod do/ /de la gang gis zhes bya ba'i sgra ni spyi yin yang / de nyid phyin ci ma log par ston par mdzad pa nyid kyis na 'dis ni bcom ldan 'das kho na dang sbyar bar bya'o/ /de nyid ces bya ba ni khyad par dag bstan du zin kyang / khyad par gyi gzhi'i ming ma bstan na de mi rtogs pas de'i phyir/de nyid ces smos te/ 'jig rten pa dang / 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos po de dag gi de nyid de/ de bzhin nyid dang / chos kyi dbyings dang /stong pa nyid ces bya ba dag gi rnam grangs so/ /rab brtag min zhes bya ba ni spyi dang ldan pa skog tu gyur pa'i don snang ba la rjes su dpog pa'i shes pas rab tu brtag par bya ba ma yin pa'am/ rtog pa dang dpyod pa rtsing ba dang / zhib pa'i rnam pas rjes su 'jug pa yang rung lhan cig 'byung ba ②yang rung ba'i spyod yul ma yin pa'i phyir ro/ /rnam shes bya min zhes bya ba ni shes bya rnam pa lnga la 'jug pa'i rnam par shes pa lngas rnam par shes par bya ba ma yin pa'i phyir ram/byis pa dang / mu stegs byed dang / slob pa dang / mi slob pa dang /rang sangs rgyas thams cad kyis rtogs par mi nus pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhi ma yin zhes bya ba ni ji ltar kun gzhi rnam par shes pa la rtog pa'i sa bon thams cad kyi gzhi yod pa dang / skyes bu la bdag grol ba rnams kyi gzhi yod pa ltar/'di la gang ①gzhi dang kun tu sbyar ba yang yod pa ma yin pa'am/ sa yul gang na yang 'di'i gzhi dang kun tu sbyar ba 'ga' yang yod pa ma yin pa'o/ /mtshon min zhes bya ba 'di rang dang spyi'i mtshan nyid kyis ④mtshon par bya ba ma yin 58—105

pa'am—/ 'dis dngos po gang yang mtshon par byed pa ma yin pa'o/ /brtag min zhes bya ba ni chos thams cad rang gi ngo bor yongs su ma grub pa'i phyir 'di dang de'o zhes brtag par mi nus pa'i phyir ro/ /rig bya min zhes bya ba ni rang byung gi ye shes skad cig gcig gis chos thams cad phyin ci ma log par rnam pa thams cad mngon par rtogs ①pas rig pa med pa'i tshul gyis rig par bya ba'o/ /skye 'jig med cing zhes bya ba ni skye ba ni 'byung ba yin la/'jig pa ni rgyun chad pa 'am zhig pa ste/ 'di la de gnyis yod pa ma yin pa'o//bde ba zhes bya ba ni skye ba la sogs pa'i gnod pa ma lus pa dang bral ba'i phyir ro//rnam brtag ma yin zhes bya ba ni gzung ba dang / 'dzin pa dang / bdag gi dngos bo dang / gzhan gyi dngos po dang / ④dngos po med par rnam pa brtag pa ma yin pa'i phyir ro/ /snang ba med ces bya ba ni rang dang gzhan du ①snang ba med pa'i phyir ro/ /mtshan ma med cing zhes bya ba ni gzugs dang gzugs med pa'i mtshan ma dang bral ba'i phyir ro/ /gsal byed med ces bya ba ni skye ba dang / gnas pa dang / 'jig pa dang / gzhan du 'gyur ba nyid ces bya ba'i gsal byed dag dang bral ba'i phyir ro/ /gnyis min gnyis med ma yin zhes bya ba ni dmigs pa gnyis dang / dmigs su med pa gnyis dang /dmigs pa dang dmigs pa med pa mnyam pa nyid kyi phyir ro/ /zhi zhes bya ba ni ye shes zhi bas rtogs par bya ba yin pa'i phyir ram/ rab tu zhi ba bla na med pa'i rgyu yin pa'i phyir ro/ /blo 'jug rnam spangs pa zhes bya ba ni don dam pa rtogs pa dang rjes su mthun pa'i shes rab 'jug pa med pa'i tshul du 'jug pa'i yul yin pa'i phyir/ mtshan ma dang bcas pa dang dmigs pa dang bcas pa'i 58—106

blo'i 'jug pa rnam par spangs pa'o/ /yi ge med pa zhes bya ba ni blo'i yul ma yin pa'i phyir/ tshig gi yul yang ma yin pas de'i phyir yi ge med pa ni brjod du med pa'o/ /yi ge yis zhes bya ba ni yi ge dag gis sgro btags te'o①/ /thugs rje nyid kyis zhes bya ba ni brtsad ④pa'i phyir ma yin par ro/ /bstan mdzad pa zhes bya ba ni rab tu bstan par gyur pa'o/ /ston pa zhes bya ba ni lha dang mi rnams la phyin ci ma log par ston pa'o/ /ma nor nyid gsung ba zhes bya ba ni don yang dag pa ji lta ba nyid gsung ba'o/ /de la zhes bya ba ni ston pa la'o//gus par zhes bya ba ni bsam pa thag pa nas so/ /phyag 'tshal lo zhes bya ba ni phyag 'tshal bar gyur cig ces bya'o①/ /de ltar na des ni bcom ldan 'das kyi rang dang gzhan gyi don phun sum tshogs pa bstan te/ rang gis dude nyid thugs su chud nas gzhan dag la ston par mdzad pa'i phyir ro/ /'o na gang gi phyir dang 'grel pa gang gis bstan bcos 'di rtsom par byed ce na/ de'i phyir/gzhan don bsgrub phyir brtul zhugs kyis/ /byang chub chen por blos byas rnams//de nyid bdud rtsir gzung duba'i phyir/ /nus pas bucung zhig brjod par bya/ /zhes smras te/ gzhan don bsgrub phyir zhes bya ba no/ gzhan dag gi don bya ba'i phyir ro/ /brtul zhugs kyis zhes bya ba ni gang dag gis ⑦brtul zhugs drag po blangs pas so/ /byang chub chen po zhes bya ba ni de byang chub kyang yin la/chen po yang yin pas byang chub chen po ste/ theg pa thams cad theg pa gcig gi rjes su 'jug pa'i phyir dang rtogs par bya ba mtha' yas pa'i phyir ro/ /der blos ⑧byas rnams zhes bya ba ni mi phyed pa'i bsam pa yang dag par bskyed pa rnams so/ /de rnams de nyid bdud rtsi la gzud pa'i phyir bstan bcos 'di 58—107

rtsom par byed de/ de ltar na de ni dgos pa yin no/ /nus pasashecung zhig brjod par bya/ /zhes bya ba ni 'byel pa yin te/ ji ltar zhe na/ gang gi phyir bcom ldan 'das kyis ②theg pa chen po'i phyir/ de nyid bdud rtsi'i yi ge dpag tu med pa dang / don shin tu rgya chen po bka' pa pa de'i rjes su slob dpon gyis kyang de dbu ma'i bstan bcos su ①rgya cher bstan gyi/ bdag gis ni blo zhan dupa rnams drang ba'i phyir ci nus pas cung zad tsam zhig brjod pa'i phyir ro/ /bstan bcos mtha' dag gi don gyi sgo nas yongs su rdzogs pa dang 'dra bar blos yang dag mthong ba na/ spyi sdom byed pa ni/ byang chub sems ni mi gtong dang / /thub pa'i brtul zhugs yang dag brten/ /de nyid shes pa tshol ⑤ba ni/ /don kun sgrub pa'i spyod pa yin/ /zhes bya ba ste/ byang chub chen por smon lam btab pa rnams kyis dang por byang chub yid la byed pa dang mi 'bral bar bya'o/ /de nas phyi rol pa'i thub pa'i chos dang mthun par theg pa chen po las gsungs pa'i thub pa'i brtul zhugs la yang dag par brten par bya'o//de'i 'og tu phyogs su lhung ba'i blo med pas gzhung lugs thams cad rnam par brtags nas rigs pa dang lung dang mi 'gal ba'i de nyid shes par bya ba'i phyir 'bad par bya ste/ de ltar spyod pa gsum po de dag ni rang dang gzhan gyi don thams cad sgrub 0pa'i spyod pa yin te/ bstan bcos 'di la mdor bstan pa ni de yin no/ /de la re zhig byang chub kyi sems mi gtong ba ji brjod par bya ste/byang chub kyi sems zhes bya ba de ji lta bu zhe na/ byams pa dang ni snying rje dang / /shes pa chen pos brgyan pa yi/ /sangs rgyas sa bon byang chub sems/ /de phyir mkhas pas dze+ede mi btang / /zhes bya ba ste/ byams pa chen po zhes bya ba 58—108

ni sems can thams cad bsgral ba dang / sgrol ba dang / mngon par byang chub par bya ba dang / yongs su rgya ngan las 'da' ba'i sems bskyed pa bzhi dang ldan pa'o/ /snying rje chen po zhes bya ba ni sems can thams cad kyi don bya ba dang / ngan 'gro las yongs su bskyab pa dang / theg pa dman pa las bslang ba dang / yang dag pa'i lam du dgod pa'i sems bskyed pa bzhi dang ldan pa'o/ /shes pa chen po zhes bya ba ni rnam pa gnyis te/ thabs kyi shes pa dang / shes rab kyi shes pa'o/ /de la thabs kyi shes pa ni 'khor gsum yongs su dag pa dang ldan pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad skyed ①cing / sems can thams cad dang thun mong du byas shing / bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yongs su bsngo ba dang / sdig pa 'chags pa dang / bsod nams kyi rjes su yi rang ba la sogs pa dang / tshogs gsum yongs su rdzogs par byed pa'o/ /shes rab kyi shes pa ni chos thams cad dmigs su med pa dang /mtshan ma med pa dang / mngon par 'du bya ba med pa dang / skye ba med pa dang / dngos po med pa dang / yongs su ma grub pas so sor rtog skepa'i ngo bo nyid kyi shes pa skad cig gcig dang ldan pa bskyed pa'o/ /de dag gis brgyan pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sa bon ni byang chub kyi sems yin te/ byang chub ni chos thams cad rnam pa thams cad du yongs su mkhyen pa'o/ /byang chub kyi sems ni byang chub kyi phyir sems pa'o①/ /gang gi phyir de sangs rgyas kyi sa bon yin pa de'i phyir mkhas pa sems can la blta bas bsam pa dang / lhag pa'i bsam pa dang mos pa dang mos pa rgya chen po de mi gtang ④bar bya ba'i rigs so/ /byang chub tu sems bskyed pas ci zhig bya bar rigs she na/ de'i phyir/ blo ldan 58—109

snying stobs che ba dang / /gzhan kyi sdug bsngal mi bzod cing / /yang dag brtson 'grus brtsams pa dang / /mthu dang ldan zhing mkhas pas ni/ /shes rab snang ba med pa yi①/ /'jig rten kun la blta byas nas/ /'khor ba mi gtsang sa 'og nas/ /bdag nyid rgal bas bsgral bar rigs/ /zhes bya ba smras te/ blo dang ldan pa chos thams cad rab tu rnam par 'byed pa'i mtshan nyid kyi shes rab dri ma med pa dang ldan pa dang / snying stobs che ba bdud dang nyon mongs pa thams cad kyis ②mi phyed cing brtan pa'i sems dang ldan pa dang /gzhan gyi sdug bsngal mi bzod pa sems can thams cad bdag nyid dang 'dra bar khas blangs nas de dag sdug bsngal bas bdag nyid sdug bsngal ba dang /yang dag par brtson 'grus brtsams pa dge ba'i chos kyi spyod pa dag la brtson 'grus brtan pa brtsams pa dang / mthu dang ldan pa bdag dang gzhan kyi don byed par nus pa dang / mkhas pa shes nyen ①can gyi ni shes rab kyi snang ba med pa blo'i gsal ba dang bral ba'i 'jig rten ma lus pa kun la blta ba yang dang yang du brtag pa byas nas 'khor ba mi gtsang ba'i sa 'og nas/ bdag nyid rgal dubs 'jig rten yang bsgral bar rigs so zhes bya bar sbyar ro/ /byams pa chen po'i bshad pa sems can thams cad bsgral ba'i sems bskyed pa zhes bya ba dang po bshad zin to/ /sems can thams cad dudagrol ba'i sems bskyed pa zhes bya ba gnyis pa'i dbang du byas nas/ gang zhig shes rab mtshon rnon gyis/ /'ching ba kun bcad grol gyur pa/ /snying rje'i bdag nyid ldan pa yis—/ /gang phyir mgon med sdug bsngal ba/ /'khor ba'i btson ra mi bzad par/ /'dod chags la sogs sgog gis bcings/ /bag med pa yi 58—110

chang 'thungs nas/ /gti mug gnyid kyis log pa dang / /rnam par rtog pa'i jom rkun gyis/ /dge tshogs ma lus rkus pa dag /gal te grol bar mi byed na//mthu ldan mthu ni ci la phan/ /zhes bya ba smras te/ gang zhig shes rab kyi mtshon nyon mongs pa ma lus pa gcod pa'i bdag nyid kyi ral gri shin tu rnon pos srid pa'i kun tu sbyor ba'i 'ching ba kun ma lus par bcad cing bdag nyid grol bar gyur pa snying rje'i bdag nyid dang ldan pas gzhan dag kyang grol bar byed pa de ni mthu dang ldan pa'i mthu yin no zhes bya bar sbyar ro/ /byams pa'i skabs su snying rje'i bdag nyid dang ldan pa zhes bya ba'i tshig smos pa ni byams pa dang snying rje gnyis zung du 'byel bar 'byung ba'i phyir mi rung ba med do/ /mgon med ces bya ba ni dad pa ①la sogs pa mgon med pa'i chos bcu dang bral ba'i phyir ro/ /sdug bsngal ba zhes bya ba ni 'chi 'pho dang yongs su tshol ②ba la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal gdung ba dag dang ldan pa'i phyir ro/ /'khor ba'i btson ra mi bzad par ①zhes bya ba ni srid pa'i 'ching ba'i gnas 'jigs ④pa mang ba skye ba dang rga ba la sogs pa'i rgyun gyi ⑤dpyang thag ma chad pa'i mtshan nyid sems kun nas nyon mongs par byed par ro/ /'dod chags la sogs sgog gis bcings zhes bya ba ni 'dod chags la sogs pa kun tu sbyor ba dgu po lcags sgog dudang 'dra ba dag gis bcings pa'i phyir ro/ /bag med pa'i chang 'thungs nas zhes bya ba ni 'dod chags dang / zhe sdang dang gti mug dang /le lo zhes bya ba bag med pa chang dang 'dra ba bsten cing stsos par gyur pa'o/ /gti mug gnyid kyis ⑦log pa zhes bya ba ni me ⑧shes pa'i gnyid kyis shin tu rmya ⑨bar gyur pa'o/ /rnam par rtog pa'i chos rkun kyis ⑩zhes bya ba ni 'dod pa dang /58—111

gnod sems dang rnam par 'tshe ba la sogs pa'i rnam par rtog pa chom rkun dang 'dra ba dag gis so/ /dge tshogs ma lus rkus ①pa dag /ces bya ba ni 'phags pa'i nor bdun gyi nor thams cad phrogs pa dag go/ /byams pa chen po'i bshad pa sems can thams cad dgrol ba'i sems bskyed pa zhes bya ba gnyis pa bshad zin to/ /sems can thams cad mngon par byang chub par bya ba'i sems bskyed pa zhes bya ba gsum pa'i dbang du byas nas/ gang zhig lag pa'i mthus bsgrubs ②pa/ /'dod pas bskyed pa'i bde chung yang / /gcig pu gdu bar za byed pa/ /de yang mkhas pas smad ①gyur na/ /'khor los sgyur dang dbang po dang / /tshangs pa la yang rab dkon pa/ /sred pa rnam par gcod pa dang / /thabs kyi sgo nas thun mong ba/ /len dang zad dang mthar thug dang / /sdug la sogs pas mi 'gyur zhing / /sdug bsngal ma lus zhi byed pa'i—/ /de nyid don rtogs bdud rtsi ci/ /zhes bya ba smras te/ re zhig 'jig rten na gang zhig rang gi lag pa'i mthus bsgrubs pa 'dod pas bskyed pa'i bde ba cha shas chung ngu yang bdag gcig pus grogs po dang / mdza' bshes dang / mgron la gcugs rjopa dang / bstabs ⑤pa med par gdu zhing 'dod pas kun nas 0dkris pa'i sems kyis za bar byed pa de yang mkhas pas smad ⑦par 'gyur te/ ser snas kun nas dkris pa'i sems dang ldan pa'i phyir ro/ /de yang de ltar 'gyur na gang zhig rang gis de nyid kyi don rtogs ⑧pas bdud rtsi rnyed nas sems can la mi ltos par bdag rang gcig pus rtogs ⑨par byed na de ji ltar smad ⑩par mi 'gyur zhes bya ba tshig gi lhag ma'o/ /de la 'khor los sgyur ba'i bde ba ni ⑪'khor lo dang / nor bu dang / glang po che 58—112
